title: Inventory & Accounts Coordinator (Cin7 Core / QBO)
description:
About the Role



We are a CPG food & beverage brand looking for a detail-oriented and highly organised Inventory & Accounts Coordinator to support the business across Cin7 Core, inventory management, purchasing, invoicing, bookkeeping, and monthly financial reconciliation.



This role sits between operations and finance — ensuring that product, inventory, customer, supplier, and accounting records remain accurate and up to date across both Cin7 Core and QuickBooks Online. The ideal candidate is highly comfortable with numbers, systems, and recurring financial processes, with the ability to work independently and spot discrepancies before they become larger issues.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Part-time

Location: Remote

Timezone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



Inventory & Cin7 Core Management

Maintain accurate product, supplier, and customer data in Cin7 Core

Manage inventory levels and maintain accurate stock visibility

Input finished product builds / recipes to support MRP and inventory planning

Map ingredient item numbers to supplier item numbers and finished goods to customer item numbers

Input and maintain customer and supplier records

Monitor inventory transactions and investigate discrepancies

Help reconcile Cin7 Core inventory records against supporting operational data

Purchasing, Invoicing & Revenue

Create and send purchase orders through Cin7 Core

Maintain accurate PO records and supporting documentation

Invoice direct customers and distributors

Manage customer-specific pricing and ensure invoices reflect agreed terms

Track revenue across Amazon, DTC, distributors, and direct customers

Reconcile sales activity across channels

Support distributor deductions and customer account adjustments as required

Bookkeeping & Accounts Support

Maintain accurate bookkeeping records in QuickBooks Online

Support accounts receivable and accounts payable administration

Record and categorise expenses accurately

Reconcile bank, credit card, and other balance sheet accounts

Match invoices, payments, and expenses to supporting documentation

Track outstanding customer balances and supplier payments

Assist with monthly expense reconciliation and month-end close preparation

Review QBO monthly and investigate discrepancies or uncategorised transactions

Maintain organised records for invoices, receipts, bills, POs, and other finance documentation

Coordinate with external bookkeepers, accountants, or finance partners where required

Reporting & Reconciliation

Reconcile Cin7 Core activity against QBO

Maintain clear revenue, inventory, and expense records

Identify differences between operational and accounting systems and resolve where possible

Support monthly reporting with accurate data pulls and reconciliations

Flag unusual transactions, missing documents, or inconsistencies promptly



Required Skills & Experience



⚠️ Cin7 Core: Hands-on experience with Cin7 Core is mandatory — candidates without this will not be considered

QuickBooks Online: Strong working experience with QBO across AR, AP, invoicing, expense reconciliation, and month-end processes

Inventory & Operations: Experience working with purchase orders, inventory records, customer pricing, supplier data, SKUs, BOMs/recipes, item mapping, and inventory transactions

Finance Administration: 2+ years in inventory administration, bookkeeping, finance administration, operations, or a similar role

Excel / Google Sheets: Strong skills required for data management and reconciliation work

Accuracy & Organisation: Excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency with recurring finance and operational tasks

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; comfortable working independently across both operational and accounting systems

Industry Background: Experience within CPG, food & beverage, e-commerce, or another physical product business preferred



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: WE'RE HIRING: Client Account Manager (CAM)
description:

To respect both your time and ours, please review the job description, qualifications, and working hours before applying. We welcome CSRs and VAs with relevant client management experience, but applications for unrelated positions or those that do not follow the instructions will not be considered.



Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine Time)

Company: Ninedot | US-Based Digital Agency



~About the Company~



Ninedot is a US-based digital agency specializing in web development, SEO, HubSpot, AI visibility, and digital marketing solutions. We help businesses grow through strategic digital services and long-term client partnerships.



~About the Role~



We're looking for a proactive, organized, and customer-focused Client Account Manager to join our growing team.



If you have experience as a Customer Service Representative, Virtual Assistant, Client Success Specialist, Account Coordinator, or Account Manager, and you're confident communicating with clients, managing requests, and coordinating with teams, we'd love to hear from you!



You don't necessarily need to have held the title of "Client Account Manager." What matters most is your ability to build strong client relationships, communicate professionally, stay organized, and take ownership of client needs.



You'll serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring smooth communication, timely updates, and excellent service delivery.



~Key Responsibilities~

* Manage client relationships from initial discovery through project completion and ongoing support.

* Communicate professionally with clients through
, meetings, and other communication platforms.

* Lead client meetings, provide project updates, and ensure timely follow-ups.

* Coordinate with project managers and internal teams to track client requests and deliverables.

* Review proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), estimates, and client communications.

* Monitor project scope, retainer hours, timelines, and client satisfaction.

* Address client concerns, manage expectations, and escalate issues when necessary.

** Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities by recommending additional services based on client needs and business goals.

** Proactively support client retention, account expansion, and revenue growth through relationship-building and strategic service recommendations.

* Maintain organized client records, meeting notes, and account updates.



~Qualifications~



* At least 2–3 years of experience in customer service, virtual assistance, client account management, client success, or other client-facing roles.

* Experience handling multiple clients, accounts, or customer relationships simultaneously.

* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

* Confident communicating with US-based clients through
 and video calls.

* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.

* Comfortable handling difficult client conversations and resolving concerns professionally.

* Ability to coordinate tasks, follow up with internal teams, and manage competing priorities.

* Ability to identify client needs, recommend relevant services, and confidently discuss upselling opportunities.

* Willingness to learn digital agency services, including websites, SEO, HubSpot, and digital marketing.

* Ability to work consistently during US Eastern Time business hours.

* Experience working in a web development, digital marketing, or service-based agency.

* Familiarity with WordPress, HubSpot, SEO, and digital marketing.

* Experience with proposals, SOWs, client onboarding, and change requests.

* Experience in upselling, cross-selling, account expansion, or client retention.

title: Japanese-English Bilingual Growth & Marketing Associate — Remote
description:
We are a technology company building and growing digital products across Asia and North America.



We are looking for a  Japanese-English bilingual Growth & Marketing Associate who wants to take ownership of real marketing and growth initiatives, not simply complete a list of virtual assistant tasks.



You will work directly with company leadership, initially helping grow one of our existing digital businesses. As we launch and develop new products, you will have the opportunity to take on broader responsibilities across marketing, growth, outreach, research, and business development.



For the right person, we are looking to build a long-term working relationship with increasing responsibility and compensation over time.



## What You’ll Work On



Your initial responsibilities will include:



* Planning and creating content for Instagram, X, and other social platforms

* Writing engaging Japanese posts, captions, and marketing copy

* Creating social graphics and short-form content 

* Managing content calendars and publishing schedules

* Researching potential users, partners, communities, creators, and businesses

* Conducting cold
 and DM outreach

* Managing follow-ups and keeping outreach organized

* Identifying new marketing and growth opportunities

* Testing different content and outreach strategies

* Tracking results and identifying what is working

* Providing a concise weekly update with results, learnings, and recommendations



We don't expect you to simply wait for instructions.



Over time, we want you to understand the business, identify opportunities yourself, propose ideas, execute them, and become increasingly responsible for growth.



Future projects may include additional technology businesses and potentially real-estate-related initiatives.



## Who We're Looking For



### Required



* Strong Japanese communication skills, especially written Japanese

* Strong written and spoken English

* Comfortable communicating professionally in both Japanese and English

* Familiarity with Instagram, X, and social media

* Strong research and organizational skills

* Comfortable learning new software and AI tools

* Reliable and able to work independently

* Proactive, willing to suggest ideas rather than only wait for tasks



### Great to Have



Any of the following would be a plus:



* Social media management experience

* Content creation or copywriting experience

* Cold
, lead generation, or outreach experience

* Experience growing an online community or consumer brand

* CRM or marketing automation experience

* Experience working with startups or technology companies

* Interest or experience in real estate



You do **not** need to already be an expert in everything above.



We care more about your communication ability, judgment, initiative, willingness to learn, and ability to get things done.



## Why Join Us?



This role is designed to become much more than a traditional VA position.



You will:



* Work directly with company leadership

* Have significant autonomy over your work

* Work across Japanese and international markets

* Learn how digital products are launched and grown

* Experiment with new marketing and growth strategies

* Use modern AI and automation tools as part of your work

* Have opportunities to take on larger responsibilities as new businesses are launched

* Have the potential to grow into a full-time and more senior role based on performance



## Working Arrangement



* Fully remote

* Approximately 20 hours per week initially

* Flexible working hours but meetings required in EST timezone



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your Japanese level and your experience using Japanese in real situations.

3. Any experience you have with social media, content creation, marketing, outreach, or lead generation.

4. Links or examples of content or social media work you have created, if available.

5. Imagine you were given responsibility for growing a consumer-facing digital business targeting Japanese users. **What would you do during your first 30 days?**



Please keep your answers concise. We are more interested in how you think than in receiving a long application.

- Brand applications for print, digital, apparel, and signage



2. Church Vision Book / Welcome Booklet



This is one of our most important projects.



We currently have a 24-page church vision guide that contains our story, mission, values, leadership philosophy, and future plans.



We like much of the written content and direction, but we're not satisfied with the current graphic design.



We also have screenshots of another church's booklet that we really love and would like to use as creative inspiration.



We're looking for someone who can transform our existing material into a beautiful, modern, professionally designed booklet that introduces people to our church and inspires them to become part of it.



Eventually, this booklet would transition from a church-plant vision guide into a permanent **"Who We Are / Next Steps"** booklet for new members and visitors.



We love clean layouts, strong typography, modern editorial design, creative photography placement, and intentional use of white space.



3. Marketing Collateral

- Church invitation cards

- Welcome and connection cards

- Brochures and promotional materials

- Event flyers and posters

- Signage and banners

- Apparel and merchandise designs



4. Digital Assets

-
 and Instagram graphics

- Editable social media templates

- Website branding elements

- YouTube thumbnails

- Church announcement slides

- Event and ministry promotional graphics



Who We're Looking For



We would love to work with someone who:



- Has experience creating professional logos and complete brand identities

- Has strong typography and editorial layout skills

- Can design beautiful multi-page brochures, booklets, and publications

- Can create original concepts rather than relying exclusively on templates

- Is experienced with Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Canva, Figma, or similar software

- Can provide organized, editable source files

- Communicates clearly in English

- Is responsive, dependable, and open to feedback

- Has experience designing for churches, nonprofits, or modern organizations (preferred but not required)



How We'd Like to Begin

We're not necessarily ready to commission every project immediately.



We'd prefer to begin with a small, paid creative concept project to see how well we work together.



This initial project would include:

1. A few initial logo and brand identity concepts for Generations Church.

2. Suggested brand colors and typography.

3. A sample cover and two-page interior spread for our vision booklet.



If we're excited about the creative direction, we'd discuss moving forward with the full brand identity, vision booklet, marketing collateral, and additional digital assets.



Our hope is to find a designer who can become a trusted creative partner as our church continues to develop and grow.



Budget & Compensation

We are looking for affordable, high-quality design services and would prefer project-based pricing rather than immediately hiring someone full-time.



We understand that pricing depends on experience and the scope of the work.



Please provide your estimated pricing in USD for the initial creative concept project, a full brand identity package, and a 20–24-page vision booklet.



We value talented designers and want to establish a relationship that works well for both parties.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



1. A link to your portfolio website or online design portfolio. This could be your personal website, Canva portfolio, Behance, Adobe Portfolio, or another platform where we can easily browse your previous creative work. We strongly prefer viewing a professional online portfolio rather than receiving Google Drive folders filled with individual files.

2. Your approximate pricing for the projects described above.

3. Your estimated turnaround time for the initial concept project.

4. The design software you use and whether you provide editable source files.



A portfolio link is required to be considered.



We're especially interested in reviewing examples of logos, complete brand identities, marketing materials, and professionally designed booklets or brochures.



We will provide our current church vision guide, design inspiration screenshots, and additional creative direction to shortlisted applicants.



We're not simply looking for someone who can make graphics. We're looking for someone who can help us build a brand.



We look forward to reviewing your work and hopefully developing a great long-term creative partnership!

title: High-Volume Wedding Photo Color Correction Artists (Lightroom + AI Workflow)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Role Type: Freelance / Contractor (Per-Gig / Per-Wedding Basis)

Capacity: Up to Full-Time Equivalent (~15 weddings/month per editor)



About the Role

We are a global wedding photography company seeking up to 4 reliable, detail-oriented photo color correction artists based in the Philippines.



In this role, you will handle the post-production color grading and correction pipeline, transforming RAW wedding captures into consistent, gallery-ready, high-resolution JPEGs that match our signature look.



We heavily leverage modern editing workflows—pairing Adobe Lightroom Classic with AI-assisted editing tools (AfterShoot) to achieve fast, cohesive results across diverse lighting and venue conditions.



Key Responsibilities

Color Correction & Exposure Balancing: Correct white balance, tint, exposure, highlights, shadows, and skin tones across full wedding galleries (typically 1,500–4,000+ RAW images per wedding).



AI-Assisted Workflow Integration: Run catalogs through AI profiles, then perform meticulous manual QC and secondary adjustments to ensure every frame is cohesive.



Volume & Consistency: Successfully turnaround an average of 12–15 weddings per month while adhering strictly to our brand presets and style guides.



Export & Delivery: Export optimized high-resolution JPEGs following exact file-naming, sizing, and sharpening protocols within agreed deadlines.



Feedback Implementation: Apply constructive client feedback and make timely revisions when required.



Requirements & Qualifications

Proven Experience: Demonstrable portfolio or track record editing high-volume event/wedding galleries.



Software Mastery: Expert proficiency in Adobe Lightroom Classic (smart previews, catalogs, batch editing) and hands-on familiarity with AI culling/editing software (ImagenAI, AfterShoot, or similar).



Color Sensitivity: Sharp eye for natural, flattering skin tones across diverse skin complexions and varying light environments (direct sun, golden hour, tungsten, reception flash).



Hardware & Connectivity:



High-performance PC or Mac capable of smoothly handling large RAW files and catalog batches.



Color-accurate, calibrated monitor.



Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50+ Mbps download/upload) with a dependable backup plan for power and internet interruptions.



Work Ethic: Strong time management, high reliability, and clear written English communication.



Compensation & Work Setup

Pay Structure: Paid per gig / per wedding completed (rates discussed upon application).



Volume: Steady flow of projects throughout the peak wedding seasons, with potential for long-term ongoing collaboration.



Flexible Hours: Work on your own schedule as long as delivery milestones (typically 1 week turnaround per gallery once assigned) are consistently met.



How to Apply

To apply, please submit the following:



Portfolio / Before-and-Afters: A link to a portfolio or Google Drive showing before-and-after samples of your wedding color correction work (particularly skin tone rendering and reception lighting).



Workflow Summary: A quick overview of your current tech setup (computer specs, monitor, internet speed) and which AI editing tools you use regularly.



Capacity: Your current monthly editing availability.



Paid Trial: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid test gallery to evaluate style matching, color consistency, and turnaround speed.

title: HR Timekeeping & Logistics Analyst
description:
Company: Cali Shipping

Job Title: HR Timekeeping & Logistics Analyst

Industry: Transportation & Logistics

Employment Type: Full-Time / Part-Time

Location: Valencia, CA



Position Overview



Cali Shipping is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and analytical HR Timekeeping & Logistics Analyst to oversee employee timekeeping accuracy, analyze driver work hours, and ensure payroll records align with actual logistics operations.



The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience reviewing timekeeping records against operational data to identify discrepancies, investigate irregularities, and coordinate necessary corrections with employees.



This position requires someone who can independently review large amounts of data, identify inconsistencies, and proactively communicate with delivery drivers and management to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing.



Key Responsibilities



Timekeeping & Payroll Analysis



Review and audit daily employee timecards for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company policies.



Compare employee clock-in and clock-out records against logistics systems, delivery route data, vehicle activity, and operational timestamps.



Identify discrepancies involving hours worked, missed punches, extended shifts, unrecorded time, and inaccurate time entries.



Analyze driver route activity, including departure times, delivery completion times, return-to-station times, and actual clock-out times.



Review meal periods, rest breaks, overtime, and potential timekeeping compliance issues.



Prepare timekeeping corrections and maintain accurate documentation supporting all adjustments.



Ensure all hours worked are properly recorded and compensated in accordance with applicable wage and hour laws.



Driver Communication & Follow-Up



Communicate directly with delivery drivers regarding missing punches, timecard discrepancies, and required corrections.



Obtain clarification from employees when time records do not align with operational data.



Follow up with drivers who fail to submit or verify their daily time records.



Explain timekeeping expectations, payroll deadlines, and company procedures professionally and clearly.



Coordinate with dispatchers and management to verify operational information when necessary.



Maintain accurate records of employee communications and timekeeping resolutions.



Data Analysis & Reporting



Analyze daily and weekly timekeeping reports to identify trends, irregularities, and opportunities for improvement.



Cross-reference multiple systems, including payroll platforms, route management software, GPS activity, and logistics databases.



Identify excessive overtime, unexplained gaps in activity, and discrepancies between scheduled and actual work hours.



Prepare reports highlighting timekeeping exceptions, overtime trends, and unresolved discrepancies.



Recommend process improvements to increase payroll accuracy and reduce administrative workload.



HR Administration & Compliance



Maintain confidential employee payroll and personnel information.



Assist with attendance tracking, timekeeping compliance, and employee documentation.



Support payroll processing by ensuring discrepancies are investigated and resolved before payroll deadlines.



Ensure corrections are based on verified information and employee input, without automatically treating periods of limited delivery activity as unpaid time.



Escalate unresolved timekeeping issues to management.



Qualifications



Required:



Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, filtering, sorting, and data comparisons.



Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies across multiple data sources.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



High attention to detail, accuracy, and organization.



Ability to communicate professionally and firmly with employees regarding timekeeping issues.



Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet strict payroll deadlines.



Experience working with confidential employee information.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Preferred:



1–3 years of experience in payroll, HR administration, timekeeping, workforce management, or data analysis.



Experience in transportation, logistics, delivery operations, or similar industries.



Familiarity with ADP, Paycom, Paychex, or comparable payroll/timekeeping systems.



Experience analyzing GPS records, route activity, delivery management systems, or employee productivity reports.



Knowledge of California wage and hour requirements, including overtime and meal/rest break regulations.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



Analytical: Comfortable comparing multiple databases and investigating inconsistencies.



Detail-Oriented: Able to identify small discrepancies that may impact payroll accuracy.



Proactive: Takes initiative to resolve issues rather than waiting for management direction.



Communicative: Comfortable contacting drivers directly to clarify and resolve timekeeping questions.



Accountable: Follows through on outstanding discrepancies until they are resolved.



Efficient: Can manage timekeeping reviews for a large workforce in a fast-paced logistics environment.



What Success Looks Like



Daily employee timecards are reviewed and discrepancies promptly identified.



Drivers are contacted and outstanding timekeeping issues are resolved before payroll processing.



Employee time records accurately reflect all hours worked.



Management receives clear reporting on overtime trends and timekeeping irregularities.



Payroll corrections and administrative workload are reduced through consistent daily auditing.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit their resume highlighting experience in timekeeping, payroll administration, Excel data analysis, HR operations, or logistics.



We are seeking a dependable, analytical professional who can take ownership of daily timekeeping accuracy and help improve the efficiency of our payroll and HR operations.

title: Growth Marketing Specialist — SaaS / Digital Products
description:
# Growth Marketing Specialist — SaaS / Digital Products 



## JOB OVERVIEW



We are a technology company building digital products for international markets.



We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Growth Marketing Specialist　who can help us acquire customers, test marketing strategies, and grow an early-stage digital business.



This is not a traditional social media management or virtual assistant role.



We are looking for someone who understands how to attract potential customers, convert them into users, and measure what is working.



You will work directly with company leadership and collaborate with an existing marketing team member who supports content creation, research, and outreach.



## What You'll Work On



- Develop and execute customer acquisition strategies.

- Identify and test organic and paid marketing channels.

- Plan, launch, and optimize Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns when appropriate.

- Develop outreach and lead generation strategies.

- Improve landing page conversion and customer onboarding.

- Analyze marketing performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Research target audiences, competitors, and market opportunities.

- Coordinate with our existing marketing team member to execute campaigns.

- Report weekly results, insights, and recommendations.



We value practical execution over complicated marketing presentations.



## Who We're Looking For



**Required:**



- Previous hands-on experience in growth marketing, customer acquisition, or performance marketing.

- Experience executing marketing campaigns independently.

- Understanding of conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and marketing funnels.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.

- Strong English communication skills.

- Comfortable working with early-stage businesses and limited marketing budgets.



**Great to Have:**



- Experience growing SaaS or technology products.

- Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, Etsy, or D2C brands.

- Experience acquiring a startup's first customers.

- Meta Ads or Google Ads experience.

- Familiarity with AI tools and marketing automation.

- Experience with landing page optimization or A/B testing.



You do not need experience with every marketing channel. We care more about your ability to identify opportunities, execute experiments, and demonstrate results.



## Why Join Us?



- Work directly with company leadership.

- Take ownership of real growth initiatives.

- Help grow digital products from an early stage.

- Experiment with different customer acquisition strategies.

- Collaborate with a small, international team.

- Opportunity for a longer-term role based on performance.



## Working Arrangement



- Fully remote

- Part-time, approximately 10–20 hours per week initially

- Flexible working hours with some overlap with Eastern Time (ET)

- Initial paid trial, with potential for ongoing collaboration

- Compensation based on experience



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction and your resume.

2. An example of a product or business you helped grow.

3. What specific marketing activities did you personally execute?

4. What measurable results did you achieve? Please include numbers where possible.

5. Imagine you are launching a new digital product with a limited marketing budget. What would you do in your first two weeks to acquire the first 10 users?



Please keep your answers concise and specific. We value demonstrated results and practical thinking over generic marketing advice.

Location: Remote - Philippines  

Employment: Part-Time, Long-Term  

Working Hours: 20 hours/week, Monday–Friday, aligned with Singapore business hours  

Salary: USD $3–$5/hour, depending on skills and experience



About the Role



I am a Singapore-based financial adviser with over 11 years of experience helping individuals and families with wealth accumulation, investments, retirement planning and insurance protection.



I'm looking for a highly organised, reliable and proactive Virtual Assistant to manage the day-to-day administrative operations of my financial advisory practice.



My business runs on established systems mainly within Google Workspace, particularly Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Docs.



You will be responsible for maintaining these systems, managing administrative workflows, communicating with clients regarding policy servicing matters, and ensuring that tasks are completed accurately and on time.



This is a long-term position for someone who takes ownership of their work and enjoys keeping an organised business running smoothly.



Key Responsibilities



1. Google Workspace & Administrative Operations



- Manage and maintain Google Drive folders, spreadsheets, documents and administrative records.

- Update client databases, tracking sheets, task lists and operational dashboards.

- Maintain accurate and consistent information across different files and systems.

- Organise documents using established folder structures, naming conventions and workflows.

- Prepare, update and format Google Docs, Sheets, Forms and other administrative materials.

- Identify incomplete information, duplicate records, inconsistencies and missing documents.

- Track deadlines, outstanding tasks and action items.

- Suggest improvements to existing workflows and systems.



2. Insurance & Investment Policy Administration



- Prepare and organise policy-related documents, forms and administrative paperwork.

- Track new applications, renewals, policy servicing requests and outstanding submissions.

- Monitor administrative matters such as missing documentation, payment status and policy servicing deadlines.

- Follow up with relevant parties on outstanding administrative requirements.

- Update client records and policy tracking sheets based on verified information.

- Maintain clear records of completed actions, pending matters and follow-ups.

- Escalate unusual, incomplete or time-sensitive matters promptly.



All regulated financial advisory activities, recommendations and financial decisions remain the responsibility of the authorised financial adviser.



3. Client Communication & Servicing Support



- Communicate professionally with clients through approved
, messaging and other designated channels.

- Respond to routine administrative enquiries regarding their insurance and investment policies.

- Request missing documents and clarify administrative requirements.

- Provide verified updates on the progress of applications and servicing requests.

- Coordinate appointments, reminders and follow-ups.

- Maintain professional, courteous and timely communication.

- Escalate policy advice, investment questions, complaints and sensitive matters to me instead of answering independently.



4. Workflow Management & Reporting



- Maintain daily and weekly task trackers.

- Prioritise tasks according to urgency and deadlines.

- Follow through on pending matters until they are resolved.

- Prepare concise progress updates and highlight outstanding issues.

- Check completed work for accuracy and completeness before marking tasks as done.

- Maintain clear records of actions taken and communications sent.

- Assist with other general administrative responsibilities as needed.



Requirements



**Essential Skills



- Strong proficiency in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Drive and Gmail.

- Comfortable with spreadsheet formulas, filters, sorting, conditional formatting and data validation.

- At least 2 years of relevant administrative, virtual assistant or operations support experience preferred.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Confident communicating professionally with clients.

- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong organisation, time management and task prioritisation.

- Able to follow established procedures carefully and consistently.

- Proactive about deadlines, follow-ups and identifying potential problems.

- Good problem-solving ability and willingness to learn new systems.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.

- High standards of confidentiality and integrity.



**Preferred, but Not Essential



- Previous experience supporting financial advisers, insurance agents or financial services companies.

- Familiarity with insurance and investment policy terminology.

- Experience with CRM systems, workflow automation or advanced Google Sheets.

- Experience supporting a Singapore-based business.



Industry-specific procedures and systems training will be provided.



What I Value



I'm looking for someone who is more than a data-entry assistant.



I value accuracy, efficiency, accountability, initiative and integrity.



You should be someone who:



- Pays attention to details without losing sight of deadlines.

- Follows instructions accurately but also thinks independently.

- Takes ownership of assigned tasks from start to completion.

- Communicates clearly when something is unclear or requires attention.

- Follows up proactively instead of waiting for repeated reminders.

- Treats confidential client information with utmost care.

- Is receptive to feedback and continuously improves.



I will provide established systems, clear expectations and guidance. In return, I expect consistency, professionalism and genuine responsibility for the work entrusted to you.



Working Arrangement



- Remote.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- Monday to Friday, with working hours aligned to Singapore business hours.

- Long-term opportunity with ongoing training.

- Salary: USD $4–$6/hour, commensurate with experience and demonstrated ability.

- Continued development and increased responsibilities based on performance.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant administrative experience.

2. Details of your experience with Google Sheets, including formulas and functions you can confidently use.

3. Any previous experience supporting insurance, investment, financial services or other client-facing businesses.

4. A short explanation of how you organise and track multiple tasks and client follow-ups.

5. A 1–2-minute video introducing yourself in English, so I can assess your communication skills.

6. Your expected hourly salary and availability.

7. Your computer specifications and internet connection details.



**Attention-to-detail test:

Begin your application with the words "Accuracy Builds Trust".



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical assessment involving Google Sheets, document organisation and professional client correspondence, using fictional client information.



I look forward to working with someone who brings professionalism, initiative and pride to their work.

title: High Ticket Sales Closer: Premium AI Systems for US Businesses (Remote, Base Up to $2,000/mo + Commission)
description:
I've worked with a lot of VAs. This is not that. I'm building a sales culture: closers who find their own buyers, run their own calls and get paid on what they close.



Base pay: you start on a $100/month trial base. Once you close your first deal or two, your base goes up to $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month, plus commission on everything you sell. Real closers here should earn well beyond the base.



This is NOT a VA, admin, appointment-setting or customer-service role. There is no task list, no schedule and no one handing you leads.

If you have never closed a deal yourself and been paid for it, please don't apply.



WHO I AM

I'm Ian, a US builder in Wisconsin (IRF LLC / AdWise Guys). I build. I don't sell. That is your whole job. My work: 



WHAT YOU SELL (bundle any of it, one-time or monthly)

- AI receptionists (answer every call and text 24/7, book jobs)

- AI employee systems (GoHighLevel automations that do the follow-up, booking and reviews)

- Websites

- 
 autopilot (my own software; I set up and run every client's campaigns; no guaranteed-results promises)

- GoHighLevel builds and rescues (CRMs built badly or never finished)



WHAT YOU DO

- Pick who to sell to and where to find them (your list, your network, your channel, your accounts)

- Do the outreach and book the calls

- Run the call, price it from my price list, close it, and get it paid through my invoice

- Hand me the signed client. I build and deliver. You go get the next one.



WHAT YOU DON'T GET

Beyond the base: no paid training time, no leads, no scripts, no SOPs, no manager, no use of my
 accounts, pages, phone numbers or logins. You get the price list, the portfolio, payment links, and me on a scoping call once you have a qualified buyer.



PAY

- Base: $100 USD per month during your trial, rising to $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month once you've closed your first deal or two.

- Your first sale: 60% commission.

- Every sale after that: 35% on one-time sales and 25% on recurring (monthly) sales.

- Commission is paid on cleared cash only. No hourly pay, no time tracking.



TO APPLY (applications without this are skipped)

Start your message with "Delavan", then answer:

1. Required: describe one deal you closed yourself. Who the buyer was (type of business), what you sold, the price, and how you found them.

2. Which of my offers would you sell first, to which kind of US business, and where will you find your first 5 prospects this week?

3. One line: "I understand I start on a $100/month trial base that rises to $1,500 to $2,000/month after my first deal or two, plus commission (60% of my first sale, then 35% one-time / 25% recurring), and this is not a VA job."

title: High Ticket Sales Closer: AI Worker Computers for US Businesses (Remote, Base Up to $2,000/mo + Commission)
description:
I’m Ian Flynn, founder of IRF LLC in Wisconsin. I build and run AI and automation systems for small businesses. I’m hiring one experienced sales closer who can find the buyer, run the sales conversation, and get the deal paid.



I build custom workflows, integrations, and tools that collect data and feed it into a CRM. I set up and repair GoHighLevel accounts, connect lead forms and calendars, and automate follow up by text and
. I also build websites, set up social workflows and
 domains, and write guides so the team can run what we build. My team and I handle the technical work, test it, and support the client after delivery.



What you’ll sell



Start with dedicated worker computers for businesses that want background work off their main laptops. I can repurpose suitable Macs with Linux, set them up for remote access, and configure them to run jobs such as data processing, reporting, and workflow automation. Where it fits the client, you can also sell AI receptionists, GoHighLevel setup and repair, websites, or custom integrations.



What you’ll own



Choose the businesses you want to approach and find your own prospects. Run outreach, discovery, and sales calls. Learn what the problem costs the buyer, present the right option using our confirmed pricing, handle objections, and follow the deal through our invoice and payment. Bring me in when technical scope or a quote needs confirmation. Once the client is signed, hand off the agreed scope and I’ll take it from there.



You’ll get the portfolio, confirmed pricing, and technical help on qualified opportunities. The work is judged on your ability to move real deals forward. Agree on scope, pricing, and timing with me before promising them to a buyer.



Portfolio: 



Pay and hours



This is a remote role, 10 hours per week. The trial base is $100 USD per month from day one. Your base rises to $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month after the first deal or two, plus commission.



We’ll review the existing commission terms on the first call.



How to apply



Tell me about one paid deal you closed yourself. What type of buyer was it, what did you sell, what did they pay, and how did you find them? Tell me which parts of the sale you handled personally. Leave out the customer’s name and any private details.



Then tell me which of our offers you’d start with, who you’d sell it to, and where you’d find your first five prospects.

title: Creative Strategist - DTC and Meta Paid Social
description:
About the Role

This is a strategy-first role. You will own the creative thinking for two to three DTC accounts — the desires we go after, the avatars we speak to, the angles we test, the concepts that carry them, and the briefs that get them made.

You do not edit video, design statics, or buy media. You will occasionally build reference frames so an editor can see what you mean, but execution is not your job. D
 what gets made, and why, is.

Most of the work sits in health, wellness, and supplements, with room to expand into other e-commerce categories. It is a crowded, compliance-tight space where the gap between a winning ad and a dead one is almost always the angle, not the production quality.



Work Structure & Requirements

Schedule: Central European Time

Compensation: 8 USD per hour **negotiable



Key Responsibilities

1. Creative Strategy

Start from the desire the product actually serves, not the feature list

Identify the core avatar and sub-avatars underneath it, defined by what they have already tried and why it failed them

Turn those into testable angles, then into concepts, then into briefs — three different things, and you brief all three

Maintain a pipeline across angles, formats, hooks, and offers, with a stated reason for every test

Balance net-new concepts against iterations of proven winners

2. Brief Writing

Produce 5–15 briefs per client per week depending on scope, across short-form video, UGC, statics, and native-style formats

Every brief ships ready to execute: hook and opening concept, core message, script or talking points, visual direction, CTA, required assets, and editing notes

Write scripts yourself — an editor should never have to come back and ask what you meant

3. Research

Mine Amazon reviews (positive and negative) for the words customers actually use

Use Google searches to find what the market is confused about

Analyze Meta Ad Library and other ad libraries — what competitors are running, how long it has been live, and the technique underneath it rather than the line itself

Review competitor sites, offers, pricing, and landing pages

Pull voice of customer from Reddit, YouTube comments, ad comments, support tickets, and forums — their own sentence reads as recognition; a paraphrased problem reads as marketing

Identify what the market has already been told and already tried, so you stop repeating a claim it stopped believing

4. Performance Review & Recommendations

Come to performance reviews having already asked for the data you need — chasing the right numbers is part of the role

Diagnose why something won or lost specifically: was it the angle or the execution?

Recommend what to kill, what to iterate, and what to leave running — with the reasoning behind each call

Feed learnings directly into the next round of briefs

5. AI Integration

Use AI as part of your workflow for research, synthesis, ideation support, reference frames, and speeding up mechanical parts of the job

Hooks, angles, and scripts come from you — not AI



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years personally owning creative strategy for DTC paid social — in-house or agency; owning it, not contributing to it

Performance Mindset: You judge creative on hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA/ROAS against a target — not on whether it looks good

Conceptual Clarity: You can explain the difference between a desire, an avatar, an angle, a concept, and a hook without hedging

Copywriting: Excellent written English and real copywriting ability — the hook is the job; you write UGC scripts yourself and brief editors and creators directly

Awareness Levels: You write for different levels of awareness and know why a hook that lands on someone already shopping falls flat on someone who hasn't named the problem yet

Iteration: You iterate deliberately — you know what to change in a winner and what to leave alone

Compliance: Comfortable inside a compliance-tight category; health and supplement claims live within real limits and you write inside them by instinct

Organization: Organized enough to carry two to three brands at once without dropping a deadline

Bonus: Agency experience, worked directly alongside Meta media buyers, experience with advertorials, VSLs, and long-form direct response



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, introduction video and portfolio

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
About Black Compass Digital:

Join us at Black Compass Digital, a dynamic and rapidly expanding digital marketing agency managing over $25 million in annual advertising revenue. We are dedicated to nurturing top-tier talent and embarking on a journey of growth and innovation together. Our team values a positive attitude and a commitment to excellence, with mandatory experience to help us achieve our ambitious goals.



The Role:

The Amazon Account Specialist (Remote work position) will be a key member of the team, seeking to work for a growing digital marketing agency. This role provides administrative, operational, and Seller Central support to help drive the growth of Black Compass Digital’s business and its clients. This role will be a partner to the stakeholders by providing quality, transparent and meaningful reporting and analysis to support key business decisions. This is a full-time job with the expectations of working 40 hours per week.



Amazon PPC experience is mandatory



Key Responsibilities

• Identify, develop, and implement long and short-term strategic direction and

plans to drive revenue.

• Report (daily, weekly, monthly) and overall account health and provide recommendations to enhance performance.

• Be responsible for Amazon store end-to-end management, increasing ranking, conversion, and overall sales.

• Develop and execute paid media campaigns across various platforms

• Ensure efficient and effective day-to-day operations across all Amazon-related activities.

• Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and ad copywriting to optimize campaign performance and drive

quality traffic.

• Continuously monitor campaign metrics, such as click-through rates (CTR), conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS), and make data-driven adjustments to improve results.

• Manage advertising budgets effectively, ensuring maximum ROl and adherence to allocated spending limits.

• Monitor daily spending and adjust campaign bids, targeting parameters, and budget allocations as needed to optimize performance and achieve objectives.

• Implement conversion tracking mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of

paid media campaigns in driving desired actions, such as form submissions, purchases, or sign-ups.



Preferred Skills and Qualities:

Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central tools and processes.

Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Effective communicator, both written and verbal.

Proactive problem-solver with a customer-focused mindset.

Ability to manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.



Benefits:

- 5 Days’ Vacation Paid Time Off

- Time Off For 9 National PH Holidays

- Company Events – Free Dinner

- Year End Bonus – We Pay 1% of Company Profits To Our Employees





SECTION 1

1. Please confirm your understanding by inserting BCD into your subject line response.

2. Please provide your resume

You will be responsible for managing advertising budgets, optimizing product feeds, testing new creatives, and maximizing our Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Campaign Management: End-to-end strategy, execution, and daily optimization of paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube) and Meta Ads

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the [design/content/marketing] team to request high-performing video and image creatives based on data insights.

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads and
/Meta Ads, preferably in an e-commerce environment.

Platform Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, Meta Ads Manager, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Description



We are hiring a Business Development Manager to own and manage the majority of our digital business. This role is ideal for someone with a strong small business background who is comfortable managing day-to-day operations and stepping into the details when needed.

This is a hands-on role. We are not looking for a high-level executive who operates far from execution. We are looking for someone who can manage and do.



Responsibilities

• Platform Ownership: Owning the end-to-end e-commerce operation across Amazon as the primary platform. 

• Vendor & Agency Management: Acting as the main point of contact for agencies and third-party vendors, including managing vendor contacts and leading negotiations. 

• Daily Operations: Overseeing technical, operational, and day-to-day e-commerce activities, including product additions, integrations, and customer service escalations. 

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Representing the company on technical, operational, and integration-related calls, and coordinating with in-person staff regarding e-commerce operations. 

• Stakeholder Communication: Communicating clearly with company owners on progress, issues, and priorities. Problem Solving: Getting hands-on when needed to resolve technical or operational issues and unblock operations.



Platforms and Experience Required

• Experience with Amazon is strongly preferred. 

• Exposure to Walmart or eBay is a plus but not required. 

• Comfort managing integrations, apps, and technical workflows. 

• Proven experience working with agencies, external partners, and managing vendor negotiations.



Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-commerce, or a related field is preferred. 

• Experience managing or supporting marketplace platforms such as Amazon, Etsy, eBay, etc. 

• Background working in product-based or multi-channel e-commerce businesses. 

• Operational Skills

• Strong understanding of end-to-end e-commerce operations, workflows, and vendor relationship management. 

• Able to manage day-to-day execution and priorities independently. 

• Comfortable working remotely and independently with minimal supervision. 

• Ability to work fully during Central Standard Time (CST) business hours. 

Nice to Have Skills

• Experience with additional third-party marketplace platforms. 

• Familiarity with e-commerce integrations, apps, and third-party tools. 

• Exposure to international e-commerce operations or cross-border selling. 

• Comfortable supporting or overseeing digital marketing initiatives in partnership with specialists or agencies. 

• Experience helping scale or integrate new brands or acquisitions into an existing e-commerce platform.



Ideal Candidate Profile

• Comes from a small business or growing company environment. 

• Is comfortable wearing multiple hats and operating without being “too high level”. 

• Is not afraid to get into the operational, technical, or negotiation details. 

• Can grow with the company as we scale and potentially acquire other businesses. 



We offer performance-based increase and HMO, as part of our many perks and benefits.



***Very important: Do take note that the applicant is required to share their updated CV with appropriate access. Applicants who are non-compliant with this will be automatically ignored.***

title: FBA Manager
description:
The Role

As our Amazon FBA Manager, you will be the captain of our Amazon storefront. You will balance daily operational logistics with long-term growth strategies to maximize revenue, maintain healthy profit margins, and protect our account standing. You will treat this channel as your own business, driving decision-making from inventory forecasting to PPC bid management.



Key Responsibilities

Listing Optimization (SEO): Create, update, and optimize product listings using competitive keyword research to maximize conversion rates. Manage A+ Content, storefront design, and backend search terms.



Inventory & Supply Chain: Forecast demand, track stock levels, and coordinate with suppliers/3PLs to ensure seamless fulfillment into Amazon centers. Prevent stockouts while actively avoiding long-term storage fees.



PPC & Promotions: Design, execute, and monitor Amazon Sponsored Ads (Products, Brands, Display). Adjust bidding strategies to maintain a profitable ACoS. Plan and execute promotions for Prime Day, Q4, and other seasonal events.



Account Health: Monitor Seller Central daily for policy warnings, stranded inventory, and listing suppressions. Escalate and resolve support cases, manage customer reviews, and ensure strict compliance with Amazon’s Terms of Service.

title: AMAZON VENDOR CENTRAL & eCOMMERCE GROWTH MANAGER
description:
About Us:

We are an established Australian premium natural beauty and wellness brand with award-winning, Australian-made products and a growing presence across retail and online channels.



We are looking for an experienced, proactive and results-driven Amazon Vendor Central & eCommerce Growth Manager to take ownership of our Amazon business, optimise our product listings and drive sustainable sales growth.



This is not a general virtual assistant or administrative position. We are seeking a hands-on eCommerce professional who understands Amazon Vendor Central (1P), has demonstrated success in improving product visibility and conversion, and can independently develop and execute growth strategies.

You will also support our Shopify store and future expansion into other eCommerce marketplaces.



Key Responsibilities

1. Amazon Vendor Central — Account Audit & Listing Optimisation

• Conduct a comprehensive audit of our existing Amazon Vendor Central account, product listings and ASINs.

• Review and optimise product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, categories and product attributes.

• Evaluate customer-facing product pages on desktop and mobile to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Optimise product images, A+ Content, Brand Story, product comparison charts and Amazon Brand Store.

• Identify and resolve listing errors, missing information, catalogue conflicts and product visibility issues.

• Conduct competitor analysis and keyword research to improve organic search rankings and conversion.

• Coordinate with our marketing and design team to develop high-quality, conversion-focused product content.



2. Amazon Sales Growth & Advertising

• Develop and execute strategies to increase Amazon product visibility, traffic, conversions and sales.

• Manage and optimise Amazon advertising campaigns, including Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands where available.

• Monitor advertising performance, ROAS, ACOS and profitability.

• Recommend appropriate promotions, product positioning and growth opportunities.

• Analyse Amazon Retail Analytics and other available performance reports.

• Prepare weekly performance reports with actionable recommendations.

• Continuously identify opportunities to improve sales and return on investment.



3. Amazon Vendor Central Account Management

• Manage Vendor Central operations, including purchase orders, fulfilment coordination and inventory monitoring.

• Investigate and resolve catalogue issues, shortages, chargebacks, deductions and account-related problems.

• Monitor product availability, operational performance and replenishment requirements.

• Liaise with Amazon support and internal teams to resolve issues efficiently.

• Ensure product content and account operations comply with Amazon policies.



4. Shopify & eCommerce Support

• Support daily Shopify operations, product listings, collections, promotions and website merchandising.

• Identify opportunities to improve the online shopping experience and conversion rates.

• Coordinate with our existing marketing, SEO and website teams.

• Assist with evaluating and developing new online sales channels and marketplaces.

Essential Requirements

• Minimum 3 years of direct, hands-on Amazon Vendor Central (1P) experience.

• Proven experience managing and optimising Amazon product listings and catalogues.

• Demonstrated success improving Amazon product visibility, conversion rates and sales.

• Strong understanding of A+ Content, Amazon Brand Stores, keyword optimisation and advertising.

• Experience using Amazon Retail Analytics and managing Vendor Central account operations.

• Ability to develop and implement growth strategies independently.

• Strong analytical skills and experience with performance reporting.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate effectively with an Australian team.

Important: Applicants with Amazon Seller Central experience only, but no practical Vendor Central experience, will not be considered for this position.



Highly Desirable

• Shopify store management experience.

• Experience in beauty, cosmetics, personal care, fragrance or wellness products.

• Experience managing Amazon Australia.

• Familiarity with Amazon advertising optimisation and eCommerce analytics tools.

• Experience expanding brands into additional eCommerce marketplaces.

• Basic knowledge of SEO, conversion optimisation and digital merchandising.



Your First 90 Days

We expect the successful candidate to:



First 30 Days

• Complete a comprehensive audit of our Amazon listings, product presentation and account performance.

• Identify critical issues, opportunities and immediate improvements.

• Present a prioritised optimisation and growth action plan.



Days 31–60

• Implement approved listing and content improvements.

• Optimise priority products, keywords and advertising campaigns.

• Resolve key catalogue and account-related issues.



Days 61–90

• Measure performance improvements against established baselines.

• Refine advertising and sales strategies.

• Deliver a clear growth plan for the following quarter.

What We Offer

• Competitive monthly salary based on experience.

• Long-term remote career opportunity with an Australian business.

• Opportunity to take ownership of an established brand's Amazon growth.

• Direct collaboration with Australian management.

• Support from an existing marketing and design team.

• Opportunity to develop into a broader eCommerce management role as our international business grows.



Day 91and after, we expect a full time staff working with us.



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your updated CV, highlighting your Amazon Vendor Central experience.

2. A brief summary of the Vendor Central accounts you have managed, including marketplaces, product categories and your responsibilities.

3. Two examples of improvements you personally implemented, including measurable results in sales, product visibility, conversion or advertising performance. Please exclude confidential client information.

4. Your experience with Shopify, if applicable.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP and earliest available start date.

Mandatory Screening Questions

All applicants must answer the following three questions as part of their application.

Question 1 — Amazon Vendor Central Experience

Have you directly managed an Amazon Vendor Central (1P) account?

If yes, please specify:

• How many years of direct Vendor Central experience you have.

• Which Amazon marketplaces you have managed (e.g. Australia, US, UK).

• Your main responsibilities and level of account ownership.

Question 2 — Amazon Listing Optimisation & Sales Results

Describe one Amazon product listing optimisation project you personally managed.

Please explain:

• What problems you identified.

• What changes you implemented.

• What measurable improvements resulted (e.g. sales growth, conversion rate, organic visibility or advertising performance).

Question 3 — Strategic Thinking & First 30 Days

Imagine you have just taken over an established Australian brand's Amazon Vendor Central account. The brand has several existing product listings, but sales are underperforming.

What would be your top five priorities during your first 30 days, and why?

Please explain your approach to reviewing product listings, improving product presentation and identifying opportunities to increase sales.

Important Application Instructions

• Please answer all three mandatory screening questions in your application.

• Applications without complete answers may not be considered.

• Candidates must have genuine, direct Amazon Vendor Central experience.

• Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an online interview and a practical Amazon listing optimisation assessment.

title: Senior Payroll Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Payroll Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



-You’ll play an important role in ensuring our people are paid accurately and on time. Your responsibilities will include:

-Processing Australian and Contractor’s payroll accurately and on schedule

-Managing payroll changes, including new starters, salary updates, leave, allowances, and terminations

-Reviewing timesheets and payroll data to ensure accuracy

-Assisting with PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, STP, and other payroll requirements

-Reconciling payroll reports and investigating discrepancies

-Responding to employee payroll queries in a timely and professional manner

-Working closely with our Finance and People Operations teams

-Supporting payroll reporting, audits, and process improvements



What We’re Looking For



We’d love to hear from you if you have:

-3+ years experience as a Payroll Officer or similar payroll role

-Experience processing Australian payroll

-A good understanding of PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, and Australian payroll requirements

-Strong attention to detail and excellent numerical skills

-Experience using payroll and accounting software

-Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

-The ability to manage deadlines and work independently

-Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

-A high level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information

-A qualification or relevant studies in Accounting, Finance, Payroll, or a related field.

-Experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth business.



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Facebook AI Video Ad Editor
description:
We are looking for an AI Video Ad Editor to join our team! You’ll turn our creative briefs into short scroll-stopping
 video ads: generating images and video, then editing them together with voice over, captions and music into finished ready-to-run ads.



We want 2+ year of experience editing short-form video ads (Meta, TikTok or UGC-style), and hands-on experience making AI-generated video ads. You don’t need to be a senior editor, but you do need to know what a good ad looks like and work without hand-holding.



**Who are we?**



We’re dedicated to making life easier for pet owners and busy mums, with products designed to keep homes comfortable, clean and stylish. Since our 2025 launch, we’ve grown rapidly through viral digital marketing, building a passionate community of customers across the US and UK. We operate with a small but mighty team focused on speed and continuous improvement, and creative is the engine behind our growth. We’re excited to bring on an editor who’ll play a real role in scaling the brand.



**What is our culture like and who is a good fit?**



Culture-fit is our #1 hiring factor. We’re a small team with a genuine will-to-win. You’re a great fit if:



- You have an eye for what’s real, especially with pets. A dog walking like a robot, plastic-looking fur, a paw that bends wrong: you catch it.

- You run with the brief. We give you the idea and you fill the gaps: the shots, the pacing, which hook leads. You make the call and tell us why, without waiting for us to d
.

- Quick, never sloppy. A rough ad never leaves your hands just to hit a deadline. You get faster by building a better workflow, not by cutting corners.

- Act on feedback. You take feedback well and use ad performance to improve the next batch.



You’ll work directly with the founder, with no politics or red tape. You can think on your feet and bring your own suggestions. If you want to be trusted with the creative and grow with a fast-moving brand, you’ve come to the right place.



**Responsibilities**



- Generate AI videos that look natural, not “AI”, from our briefs

- Edit clips into
 ads mainly under 
 (hook, captions, sound, call to action)

- Make variations based on existing concepts

- Learn from ad performance & feedback to make each batch better than the last

- Log repeatable prompts/workflows so we can produce quicker and more consistently



**Requirements**



- 2+ years editing short-form video ads (Meta, TikTok or UGC-style)

- Portfolio of AI-generated ads you personally made

- Hands-on experience creating AI images, video, voice over

- Proficient in AI tools e.g. Higgsfield (Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana), ElevenLabs, and Claude/ChatGPT

- Strong in CapCut (or Premiere Pro): captions, pacing, transitions & music

- Bonus points: Experience with pet/dog brands & UGC-style ads



**How our hiring works**
