title: Senior Accounts Payable Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team and support the day-to-day accounts payable operations of an Australian company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor accounts, reconciling transactions, and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time. The role will primarily use Dext and Xero will work closely with the Australian finance and operations teams.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who enjoys working with numbers, following and improving processes, and maintaining accurate financial records.



What you'll do

-Process and code supplier invoices accurately in Dext and Xero

-Organize scheduled payments and prepare them for approval

-Handle urgent payments through Airwallex

-Respond to supplier queries and collaborate with the team on Slack

-Support month-end tasks and share ideas for improving how we work



What we're looking for

-3+ years in AP or a similar finance role

-Experience in supporting Australian businesses

-Experience with Xero and Dext

-Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly and accurately

-Reliable, organized, and takes ownership of their work

-Clear written English

-Bonus: experience improving or automating finance processes



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Remote Fashion Graphic Designer | Streetwear & Lifestyle Brands
description:
# 725 PRINT LAB, INC.

## Remote Fashion Graphic Designer

**Specialization: Streetwear, Lifestyle Apparel & Fashion Branding**



**Location:** Remote  

**Position Type:** Freelance / Contract (Potential for Ongoing Work)  

**Department:** Creative & Design  

**Reports To:** Creative Director / COO



### About 725 Print Lab



725 Print Lab is a creative apparel decoration and branding company based in High Point, North Carolina. We specialize in screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF) printing, and custom merchandise production.



We are expanding our creative capabilities to support original lifestyle apparel brands, streetwear collections, and fashion-focused merchandise.



Our goal is to create apparel that consumers want to wear because of its design, quality, and cultural relevance—not simply because it features a logo.



### Position Overview



We are seeking a talented, fashion-forward **Remote Fashion Graphic Designer** who understands streetwear culture, lifestyle branding, contemporary fashion, and apparel design.



The ideal candidate is more than a traditional graphic designer. We want a creative thinker who understands how to translate concepts, stories, cultural influences, and brand identities into compelling apparel graphics.



This designer will help develop original graphics and cohesive collections for 725 Print Lab's retail brands, including WOVEN 336, as well as fashion-focused client projects.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Fashion & Streetwear Design**



- Create original T-shirt, hoodie, sweatshirt, hat, and lifestyle apparel graphics.

- Develop streetwear-inspired designs incorporating typography, illustrations, vintage influences, and contemporary fashion aesthetics.

- Design collections that reflect current fashion trends while maintaining a distinct brand identity.

- Create minimalist, quiet-luxury, oversized graphic, and premium streetwear concepts.

- Develop graphics that connect with consumers through storytelling, culture, and visual identity.



**2. Apparel Collection Development**



- Collaborate with leadership to develop seasonal collections and capsule releases.

- Create coordinated graphics across multiple apparel styles.

- Develop color palettes, typography systems, and design directions for new collections.

- Produce mood boards and creative concepts before finalizing artwork.

- Create designs suitable for retail sales, online stores, and limited-edition releases.



**3. Brand Identity & Creative Development**



- Help establish recognizable visual identities for lifestyle and streetwear brands.

- Design custom typography, monograms, emblems, and original graphic elements.

- Maintain brand consistency across apparel collections.

- Research fashion trends, streetwear culture, and emerging design movements.

- Translate creative briefs into original, commercially appealing designs.



**4. Production-Ready Artwork**



- Prepare professional artwork for screen printing, DTF, and embroidery.

- Create vector artwork and properly organized production files.

- Understand spot colors, Pantone matching, separations, and printing limitations.

- Develop designs that balance creativity with production efficiency.

- Provide properly sized artwork for different garment placements.

- Work with the production team to ensure designs can be manufactured accurately.



**5. Remote Collaboration**



- Participate in virtual creative meetings and design reviews.

- Manage assigned projects and meet established deadlines.

- Communicate progress and provide timely revisions.

- Maintain organized design files and project folders.

- Collaborate with customer service, artwork, and production teams.



### Required Qualifications



- Strong portfolio demonstrating streetwear, lifestyle apparel, or fashion graphic design.

- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.

- Strong understanding of typography, composition, color, and fashion aesthetics.

- Experience creating original apparel graphics.

- Ability to design for different consumer audiences and fashion styles.

- Understanding of screen printing and apparel decoration techniques.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Strong communication, time management, and organizational skills.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience designing for established or emerging streetwear brands.

- Experience developing complete apparel collections.

- Knowledge of garment washes, vintage treatments, distressed graphics, and specialty print effects.

- Familiarity with embroidery and premium apparel decoration.

- Experience developing tech packs or apparel specification sheets.

- Understanding of fashion merchandising and retail product development.

- Experience with licensed merchandise and brand guidelines.



### Creative Styles We Want to Explore



Our ideal designer should be comfortable working across multiple fashion aesthetics:



- **Modern Streetwear:** Bold graphics, oversized typography, and culturally relevant concepts.

- **Quiet Luxury:** Minimal branding, refined typography, subtle embroidery, and premium visual identities.

- **Vintage & Heritage:** Distressed artwork, retro typography, and nostalgic graphics.

- **Urban Lifestyle:** Contemporary designs inspired by art, music, architecture, and culture.

- **Collegiate Lifestyle:** Fashion-forward interpretations of university and campus culture, following applicable licensing requirements.

- **Minimalist Fashion:** Clean graphics, subtle details, and timeless apparel design.



### Expected Deliverables



Depending on the project, designers may be responsible for providing:



- Original design concepts and mood boards.

- Two to three initial design directions per assigned project.

- Apparel mockups showing realistic garment placement.

- Final vector artwork in AI, EPS, PDF, or SVG format.

- High-resolution PNG files with transparent backgrounds.

- Color specifications and production notes.

- Organized and editable source files.

- Revisions based on approved creative direction.



Final deliverables, revision limits, and deadlines will be established in each project brief.



### Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by:



- Originality and overall quality of design concepts.

- Ability to create commercially appealing apparel graphics.

- Consistency with established brand identity.

- Timely completion of projects and revisions.

- Accuracy and organization of production files.

- Ability to translate creative direction into finished products.

- Effective communication with the 725 Print Lab team.



### Portfolio Requirements



Applicants must submit a portfolio demonstrating fashion-focused apparel design.



We are particularly interested in seeing original streetwear collections, lifestyle T-shirt graphics, typography-based designs, vintage-inspired artwork, and premium minimalist branding.



Applicants should identify which work they personally created and, where possible, show how designs were translated into finished garments.



**A portfolio consisting only of corporate logos, flyers, or traditional promotional T-shirts will not be sufficient for this position.**





Compensation will be based on experience, portfolio quality, project complexity, and the agreed scope of work.



The initial engagement may be project-based, with the opportunity to establish a consistent, long-term creative partnership.



### How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit:



1. A portfolio of relevant streetwear and lifestyle apparel work.

2. A brief introduction outlining their fashion design experience.

3. Their preferred project rates or hourly rate.

4. Their availability and typical turnaround times.

5. Examples of completed apparel collections, if available.



**725 Print Lab, Inc.**  

High Point, North Carolina  

*Creative Apparel. Production Expertise. Brand Development.*

title: Trading Card Inventory and Pricing Specialist — Remote, Philippines
description:
Company: Lyons Cards

Pay: US $6–$8 per hour, based on relevant experience

Location: Remote, Philippines



Lyons Cards is a U.S. sports-card and collectibles business seeking an experienced trading-card specialist to manage inventory, research prices and maintain accurate marketplace listings.



This is not an entry-level virtual assistant position. Please apply only if you already understand trading cards and have hands-on experience managing online listings.



Required experience



Strong knowledge of sports cards and familiarity with Pokémon and other trading cards.

Ability to distinguish base cards, inserts, parallels, numbered cards, autographs, memorabilia cards and rookie cards.

Understanding of card condition, professional grading and the difference between a card grade and an autograph grade.

Experience creating and managing listings on eBay or Shopify, plus experience with Card Dealer Pro or a comparable inventory system.

Ability to research recent sold prices and identify genuinely comparable cards by year, set, variation, condition and grade.

Strong written English, spreadsheet skills and attention to detail.

Reliable internet and availability for scheduled overlap with our U.S. team.

What you will do



Enter and maintain card records, including photos, descriptions, purchase costs, SKUs, categories and pricing bands.

Check for duplicate records and confirm that photos match the listed card.

Research pricing and submit recommendations within our approval process.

Publish approved cards to connected marketplaces and verify that listings went live.

Resolve listing errors and keep inventory accurate across channels.

Monitor aging inventory and flag cards that need a fresh pricing or selling review.

Provide a daily report of cards processed, priced, listed and still requiring attention.

What success looks like



Accurate card identification, reliable inventory, timely listings and clear follow-through. We need someone who takes ownership and catches mistakes before they reach a customer.



Please do not apply if



Your experience is limited to general data entry or virtual-assistant work.

You have no practical trading-card knowledge.

You have never created or managed marketplace listings.

You rely entirely on AI to identify cards or determine prices. AI may assist your work, but you must be able to verify its accuracy.

How to apply



Please include:



Your trading-card experience and the sports or TCG categories you know best.

The marketplaces and inventory systems you have personally used, and what you did in each.

Two examples of card listings you created or managed. Remove confidential information.

A brief explanation of how you would identify and price a numbered parallel compared with its base version.

Your availability in Philippine time and your requested hourly rate within $6–$8 USD.

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment covering card identification, pricing research and listing accuracy.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Financial Accountant for an established Australian apparel group that supplies retailers in Australia and internationally across several brands and business units.



This is a group role. You will report to the Group Financial Controller, work across the whole group, and step in to support individual business units as priorities shift. You own the month-end timetable: actuals by working day 5 and balance sheet reconciliations by working day 7. You must be able to work independently, own your deliverables, and collaborate with teams across the business, while asking for support when you need it.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run month-end actuals by working day 5: bank reporting, royalty, discount and rebate accruals, standard costing adjustments, prepayments, sundry accruals and fixed assets

- Post monthly payroll, annual leave, long service leave and payroll tax journals

- Prepare AASB 16 (leases) entries and allocate shared service costs across the group

- Complete monthly balance sheet reconciliations by working day 7

- Prepare monthly P&L and variance analysis

- Prepare and lodge the monthly BAS and annual FBT returns

- Support the annual audit with clean, reconciled records

- Manage reporting and analysis for the business using TM1

- Support AR and AP when needed, and support business units across the group as workloads change



MUST-HAVES

- Fluent English, spoken and written (non-negotiable)

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

- Proven experience as a Financial Accountant or in a similar role

- Strong month-end, accruals, reconciliations and P&L variance experience

- Knowledge of Australian requirements such as BAS, FBT and AASB 16

- Hands-on ERP experience, ideally Microsoft Dynamics AX

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision and cross-functionally with multiple teams

- Strong Excel and analytical skills, high attention to detail and integrity

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and available 9am to 5pm Sydney time



HIGHLY REGARDED

- CPA (or working towards it)

- Apparel21 (AP21), IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) and Xero

- Experience in a multi-entity or group finance environment

- Apparel, fashion, retail or wholesale industry experience



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, answer these 3 questions in your application. Start your subject line with FA-450.

1) Which ERP/finance systems have you used hands-on (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX, AP21/Apparel21, TM1, Xero) and for how long?

2) Describe your month-end close and group/multi-entity reconciliation experience, including intercompany.

3) Can you work 9am to 5pm Sydney time full-time, and what is your notice period?

title: Inside Sales Assistant
description:
Full-Time | 8.5 Hours per Day | 8am to 5pm AEST (Sydney, NSW, Australia)



About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Inside Sales Assistant to join our team and provide essential administrative and sales support.



This role plays an important part in supporting our sales representatives by managing incoming leads and enquiries, maintaining accurate customer and account information, and ensuring our CRM system remains up to date and reliable.



Working closely with the sales team, you will help identify new business opportunities, maintain the integrity of our customer database, and ensure leads and enquiries are directed to the right people in a timely manner.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, has strong administrative capabilities, and takes pride in keeping systems organised and accurate.



Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Management & Distribution



Monitor and process incoming Cordell leads.

Review new business opportunities and ensure they are accurately recorded in the CRM.

Assign and distribute leads to the appropriate sales representatives.

Maintain accurate lead records and tracking to support the sales pipeline.

2. Customer Enquiries Management



Monitor the Enquiries Inbox and Sales IQ Chat.

Review incoming customer and prospective customer enquiries.

Allocate enquiries to the appropriate sales representative or team member.

Ensure enquiries are recorded in the CRM where required.

3. Industry Research & Newsletter Review



Review industry newsletters and communications to identify relevant business information.

Identify potential sales leads, business developments and changes to existing customer accounts.

Research and identify new contacts, facilities and company information.

Update CRM records to ensure information remains current and accurate.

4. CRM & Database Management



Create new customer and contact records on behalf of the sales team.

Verify contact information for accuracy and completeness.

Review account records to ensure the correct Account Type is assigned.

Ensure facilities are linked to the appropriate Parent or Group Account.

Update and transfer accounts between sales representatives as required.

Maintain accurate account lists and customer records.

Identify and correct duplicate, incomplete or incorrectly formatted records.

5. Data Governance & Quality Assurance



Complete scheduled CRM data governance activities to maintain database accuracy and integrity.

Conduct monthly Head Office and facility verification checks.

Audit account structures and ensure facilities are correctly linked to their Parent Accounts.

Review contact records to identify duplicates, spelling errors and incomplete information.

Conduct annual industry bed-count verification and update CRM records where required.

Follow established data governance processes and reporting requirements.

6. General Sales & Administrative Support



Provide day-to-day administrative assistance to the sales team.

Assist with ad-hoc projects and administrative tasks as required.

Support the smooth running of sales operations while ensuring core responsibilities are prioritised.

Experience with Zoho CRM would be highly regarded.



To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:



Previous experience in an administrative, sales support or customer service role.

Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when working with data.

Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

Confidence using ZOHO CRM systems and maintaining customer databases.

Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Outlook and other Microsoft Office applications.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

The ability to research, review and interpret business information.

The ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.

A proactive approach to identifying errors, improving processes and maintaining data quality.

A positive, team-oriented attitude and a willingness to support others.



What We Offer:

Starting hourly rate of $8 per hour > with ability for an increase once established within your role.

An opportunity to play an important role in supporting a growing sales team.

A varied position combining lead management, research, CRM administration and sales support.

The opportunity to develop your CRM, data management and business administration skills.

A supportive and collaborative team environment.

A role where your attention to detail and contribution will make a real difference.





Interested?

If you are organised, proactive and enjoy working behind the scenes to help a sales team succeed, we would love to hear from you.



Apply now using the link below and become an important part of our team!



https://zrec.au/mIvCb?source=CareerSite

description:

Appointment Setter



Overview

Apollo Media is a marketing company catered toward the kitchen and bathroom remodeling industry. We help business owners by building professional websites, automating customer relationship management, running
 ads, and helping them rank higher on Google. We are looking to hire two experienced cold callers to prospect local American businesses and set appointments for our sales team.

2+ years of cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting experience.

Excellent spoken and written American English: clear, neutral, and easy for U.S. business owners to understand.

Organized and proactive employees who are comfortable managing daily outreach activity with minimal supervision.

Introduce Apollo Media's services and explain how we help remodelers capture more inquiries and book more jobs.

Qualify prospects, handle basic objections, and book qualified discovery calls for our sales team.

Follow up with warm leads and past inquiries.

Maintain accurate records of every call, conversation, and appointment in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

Collaborate with the sales team to refine outreach and improve booking rates.

Specific targets will be set after training. Performance is measured on:

Completed outbound calls per day

Booked appointment show rate (those who actually attend)

Organized follow-up completion

, and you have to keep dialing for the full 4 hours anyway with no one standing over you. Every call is logged and reviewed, and your performance is tracked daily. Reliable wired internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps; 50+ Mbps preferred).

Quiet, dedicated workspace for calls.

Quality headset with microphone.

Desktop or laptop computer (Windows 10/11 or macOS).

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary connection) in case of outages.

Performance bonus: $150 USD for each qualified appointment that turns into a closed sale.

ADDITIONAL BONUS - Pay Increase: Hit 12+ held demos in a month on your part-time schedule and earn $5.50/hour the next month. Hit 20+ and earn $6/hour the next month.

Remote position

The business is an Australian accounting, tax advisory, and commercial finance practice. title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Specialist to manage and optimize advertising campaigns across multiple Amazon accounts.



This is a client-facing role, so the ideal candidate should be comfortable presenting performance updates, explaining strategy, answering client questions, and communicating recommendations clearly.



You will be responsible for day-to-day campaign management, performance analysis, keyword and targeting expansion, and identifying opportunities to improve sales and advertising efficiency. You will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead to execute account strategies and ensure campaigns are consistently optimized toward client goals.



Key Responsibilities

* Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Perform regular campaign audits and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.

* Conduct keyword, search term, competitor, and ASIN targeting research.

* Build and manage brand, non-brand, product targeting, category targeting, and defensive campaigns.

* Monitor and optimize bids, budgets, placements, keywords, and product targets.

* Analyze performance across campaign, keyword, search term, and ASIN levels.

* Track key metrics including Spend, Sales, ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, CVR, and Orders.

* Identify high-performing search terms and opportunities for campaign expansion.

* Identify inefficient campaigns and targets and take appropriate optimization actions.

* Monitor budget utilization and ensure spend is aligned with account goals.

* Identify PPC opportunities that can support organic ranking and overall sales growth.

* Consider inventory, pricing, conversion rate, and other factors when analyzing advertising performance.

* Prepare and support weekly and monthly performance reporting.

* Join client calls and present campaign performance, insights, and next steps.

* Explain advertising strategy and performance in a clear and concise way.

* Respond to client questions and provide data-backed recommendations.

* Use AI tools and PPC management software to support analysis, reporting, campaign, optimization, research, and workflow efficiency.

* Clearly document optimizations, findings, tests, and recommended next steps.

* Stay current with Amazon Ads updates and advertising best practices.



Requirements

* At least 5+ years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience.

* Strong experience managing Amazon advertising accounts.

* Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display.

* Strong understanding of keyword targeting, product targeting, match types, search term harvesting, negatives, placements, bids, and budget management.

* Comfortable analyzing advertising data using Excel or Google Sheets.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to diagnose changes in sales and advertising performance and determine potential causes.

* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Comfortable speaking directly with clients and presenting performance updates and recommendations.

* Ability to communicate complex advertising topics in a simple, business-focused way.

* Comfortable using AI tools, automation, and PPC management software as part of day-to-day campaign management.

* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools, platforms, and workflows.



Preferred Experience

* Strong Amazon PPC experience

* Amazon DSP experience is a plus



Performance KPIs

Performance will be evaluated across account results, execution quality, client management, and strategic contribution.

1. Account Performance

* Maintain PPC performance within the agreed client targets for ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, sales growth or profitability.

* Identify declining performance early and take corrective action.

* Improve efficiency or scale spend where opportunities exist.

* Maintain appropriate budget pacing throughout the month.

* Reduce unnecessary spend and continuously identify opportunities to improve campaign performance.



Target: Managed accounts meeting or progressing toward their agreed advertising objectives each month.



2. Optimization & Execution

* Complete scheduled account optimizations consistently and on time.

* Maintain clean campaign structures and accurate naming conventions.

* Regularly review search terms, keywords, ASIN targets, bids, placements, negatives, and budgets.

* Launch approved campaigns and tests within agreed timelines.

* Ensure campaign changes are properly documented.



Target: Planned optimizations and campaign tasks completed by deadline, with minimal execution errors.



3. Proactive Growth & Testing

* Identify new keyword, product targeting, category targeting, and campaign opportunities.

* Recommend and execute structured tests based on account performance.

* Surface opportunities to scale successful campaigns or products.

* Use PPC data to support broader recommendations around conversion, ranking, inventory, pricing, or listing performance.



Target: At least 2 meaningful growth or optimization recommendations per account per month, where applicable.



4. Client Communication

* Come prepared to client meetings with clear performance insights and recommended next steps.

* Communicate account changes and issues proactively.

* Respond to client questions accurately and professionally.

* Explain advertising performance in a way that is easy for clients to understand.



Target: Client deliverables completed on time, with no recurring communication or preparedness issues.



5. Reporting & Analysis

* Deliver accurate weekly and monthly reporting.

* Go beyond reporting metrics by explaining what changed, why it changed, and what should happen next.

* Ensure reporting data is accurate and aligned with Amazon Ads and account performance.



Target: 100% of reports delivered by deadline with accurate data



6. AI & Tool Adoption

* Effectively use approved AI tools, automation, and PPC management software to improve efficiency.

* Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work without compromising accuracy.

* Adopt new tools and workflows introduced by the team.



Target: Consistent use of approved tools and demonstrated improvement in workflow efficiency.



What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can think beyond simply adjusting bids.



You should be able to look at an account and determine:

* Where there are opportunities to grow sales.

* Which keywords or targets should be expanded.

* Where advertising budget is being wasted.

* Which products should receive more advertising support.

* Why sales, conversion, or advertising performance changed.

* Whether performance issues are related to PPC, inventory, pricing, conversion, or other factors.

* What actions should be taken next.

* Where AI, automation, or PPC management tools can help improve efficiency and decision-making.



You should be comfortable managing campaigns independently, making data-backed recommendations, and confidently discussing those recommendations directly with clients.



Success in This Role

Success means consistently delivering against client advertising objectives, maintaining strong execution standards, proactively identifying growth opportunities, communicating clearly with clients, and managing accounts with minimal supervision.

title: AI Automation Engineer (Full-Stack & AI Agent Developer)
description:
Location: Remote

Job Type: Part-time or Full-time, long-term

Pay: Monthly rate in PHP, based on experience



About Nextgen Pest Solutions

Nextgen Pest Solutions is a veteran-owned pest control company protecting homes and businesses across Florida, Georgia, and Alabama. We run on the same values that shaped our founder’s service: discipline, integrity, accountability, and a team that has each other’s backs.



Now we’re building the next chapter. We want to put AI to work across every part of our company and develop our technology in-house, instead of relying on outside agencies and software vendors. We’re looking for an expert-level AI Full-Stack Engineer and AI Agent Developer to help us build it.



Please read carefully before applying.



This is not a basic automation position.



This is not a position for someone whose primary experience is Zapier, Make, GoHighLevel workflows, or writing ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok prompts.



We need someone who writes real code, builds real applications, develops AI agents, works with APIs and databases, and turns business problems into working software.



What You’ll Do

You’ll work directly with leadership to take ideas and business problems and turn them into applications, AI agents, automations, and internal tools.



Build AI Agent Employees

We want specialized AI agents that support our team across:



Marketing and SEO

Website management

Lead management and sales follow-up

Customer service

Recruiting and hiring

Data management and reporting

Administrative processes

Internal operations

Our goal is not simply to use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity.



We want AI agents that access the right company knowledge, use tools, communicate with APIs, perform tasks, make decisions within defined rules, and escalate to a human when needed.



Build Custom Field Applications

Our technicians and inspectors are the backbone of Nextgen. You’ll build field-service applications that combine mobile data collection, calculations, external APIs, AI/computer vision, databases, and automated workflows, so our people in the field spend less time on paperwork and more time serving customers.



We have many more ideas for custom software and AI systems throughout the company.



What We’re Looking For

Technical Skills

You should have strong experience with several of the following:



Python, JavaScript/TypeScript

React/Next.js or similar modern frameworks

Backend development, REST APIs, webhooks

OAuth/authentication

SQL/PostgreSQL and database architecture

Git/GitHub and cloud deployment

AI/LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Gemini, or similar)

AI tool/function calling and agent architecture

RAG/knowledge retrieval and vector databases

Computer vision

API integrations: Google, Meta, GoHighLevel

n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms

Experience using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or other AI coding tools to speed up development is highly desirable.



We don’t expect one person to know everything on this list. We care more about your ability to architect solutions, write quality code, learn quickly, troubleshoot, and ship working products.



The Kind of Teammate We Want

We want someone who can hear “Here’s the problem we’re having in the business” and then figure out how technology can solve it.



At Nextgen, we value people who take ownership. You don’t need every step handed to you. You ask good questions, understand the mission, propose solutions, build them, test them, and keep improving them.



You should be:



An excellent problem solver

Highly experienced with AI-assisted development

Comfortable building applications from scratch

Comfortable integrating multiple platforms through APIs

Able to work independently

Curious about how businesses operate

Willing to challenge an idea when there’s a better technical solution

Focused on building systems employees actually use

Able to explain technical concepts to non-developers

Looking for a long-term opportunity

Expert Level Only

Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



Building basic Zapier automations

Building 
 scenarios

Creating basic GoHighLevel workflows

Prompt engineering

Using no-code tools without programming experience

Creating websites from templates

Those skills have their place, but this position requires real software development experience.



What We Offer

A long-term role building Nextgen’s AI and technology capability from the ground up

Direct access to leadership and a real voice in what gets built

A steady stream of meaningful projects across the business

Remote work, part-time or full-time

A veteran-led team culture built on respect, accountability, and pride in the work

We’re not looking for someone to complete one project and disappear. For the right person, this becomes a long-term position, continuously building new applications, AI agents, automations, and systems as Nextgen grows.



How to Apply

Please answer all of the following: 



1. Your most advanced AI build.

Tell us about the most advanced AI application or AI agent you’ve personally built. What does it do, what technologies did you use, what APIs/models does it connect to, and what did you personally build?



2. Proof of work.

Show us something you’ve actually built: GitHub repositories, live applications, Loom videos, screenshots, or portfolio links.



3. Full-stack experience.

Describe your experience building full-stack applications from scratch. What languages, frameworks, databases, and cloud platforms do you normally use?



4. An agent that takes action.

Tell us about an AI agent you built that performs tasks or uses tools, not simply answers questions. What tools can it access, and what actions can it perform?



5. Your AI coding workflow.

How do you use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools in your development workflow?



6. Technical challenge: fumigation app.

Our field inspectors measure homes for structural fumigation. A structure may be divided into multiple sections. For each section, the inspector enters eave height, peak height, length, and width. The app calculates average height and cubic volume, then combines all sections into total cubic footage.



Eventually, we want the system to use property data, aerial imagery, and/or computer vision to prepopulate some measurements and property characteristics, while letting the inspector verify them.



Briefly explain how you’d architect this. We’re interested in how you think about architecture, reliability, data validation, APIs, mobile usability, and AI, not a specific tech stack. We’re not looking for a perfect answer.



7. Expected rate.

What is your desired monthly rate in Philippine Pesos?



If you’re an engineer who gets excited when someone says “I have a crazy idea. Is there a way we can build this?”, we want to hear from you.

title: CPA – Accounting Team Manager (Remote)
description:
Company: M-TRACCS

Position: CPA / Accounting Team Manager

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Accounting, Finance & Trucking Logistics



About M-TRACCS



M-TRACCS is a fast-growing North American accounting and financial management firm specializing in the trucking and transportation industry.



We go beyond traditional bookkeeping. We act as an outsourced finance department for trucking companies across Canada and the United States, combining modern technology, dedicated accounting teams, and strategic financial reporting to help our clients grow profitably.



We're building a talented team in the Philippines and looking for an exceptional CPA who can lead people, take ownership, and help us scale.



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced CPA and natural leader to manage our growing team of accounting professionals in the Philippines.



This is not just an accounting position — it's a leadership role.



You'll oversee multiple client accounts, manage and develop accounting staff, ensure work is completed accurately and on time, and continuously improve our processes.



We're looking for someone who can think independently, solve problems, and build a high-performing team without needing constant supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Team Leadership & Management



Lead, coach, and supervise a team of accounting professionals.



Assign tasks, manage workloads, and monitor performance.



Ensure accountability, productivity, and high-quality work.



Train and develop team members as we expand.



2. Client Accounting & Financial Reporting



Oversee accounting operations for multiple Canadian and U.S. trucking clients.



Review bookkeeping, AP/AR, payroll, bank reconciliations, and month-end closing.



Ensure accurate and timely monthly financial statements.



Review financial reports and identify discrepancies before they reach clients.



Support client onboarding and accounting system implementations.



3. Process Improvement & Technology



Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).



Identify inefficiencies and implement better workflows.



Leverage QuickBooks Online, automation, and integrated accounting tools.



Help build scalable processes that allow M-TRACCS to grow efficiently.



4. Communication & Problem-Solving



Provide regular updates to North American management.



Proactively identify and resolve accounting and operational issues.



Ensure deadlines are consistently met.



Take ownership of challenges and recommend practical solutions.



Qualifications



Required:



Licensed Philippine CPA.



Minimum 5 years of accounting experience.



Previous experience supervising or managing accounting teams.



Strong knowledge of financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end close.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.



Ability to manage multiple clients and competing deadlines.



Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



Highly Preferred:



Experience with QuickBooks Online.



Experience working with Canadian or U.S. accounting clients.



Background in an outsourcing, BPO, or accounting services firm.



Experience implementing accounting systems and improving processes.



Previous experience in a Big Four or other professional accounting firm.



Who Will Succeed at M-TRACCS?



We value people who:



Take ownership: You don't wait to be told what to do.



Think critically: You find solutions, not just problems.



Lead by example: You hold yourself and your team to high standards.



Love efficiency: You're constantly looking for smarter ways to work.



Are detail-oriented: Accuracy and deadlines matter.



Want to grow: You're excited about building something bigger than yourself.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience.



Attractive benefits package.



Permanent work-from-home opportunity.



Career growth into senior management as M-TRACCS expands.



Opportunity to work with North American clients and modern financial technology.



Supportive, ambitious, and collaborative team environment.



A chance to play a key leadership role in a rapidly growing company.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a short introduction answering the following:



How many accounting professionals have you directly managed, and how did you measure their performance?



Describe a time you identified a serious accounting or operational issue and solved it without being asked.



What systems or processes have you implemented to improve your team's efficiency?



Why are you interested in joining a growing company like M-TRACCS?



We're not just hiring an accountant. We're looking for a leader who wants to help build an exceptional accounting team.

title: Influencer & Creator Outreach Specialist
description:
REBORN is looking for a full-time Influencer & Creator Outreach Specialist to work closely with our Influencer Manager on campaigns for great brands. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives and breathes social content, loves discovering creators, and knows how to start genuine, professional conversations with them.



What you'll do

• Research and shortlist relevant creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and emerging platforms, with a clear reason each person fits the brief.

• Assess content quality, audience relevance, engagement, brand fit and previous partnerships. Keep creator lists accurate and up to date.

• Find the right contact details, write personalised outreach, follow up thoughtfully and keep conversations moving.

• Gather initial information such as availability, indicative fees, content formats and timelines, then hand over clear notes to our Influencer Manager.

• Maintain organised outreach trackers so the team can see who has been contacted, what they said and what needs to happen next.

• Keep an eye on creator trends, new formats and rising talent, and share useful ideas with the team.



What we're looking for

• Hands-on experience in social media, creator research, influencer outreach or creator partnerships.

• A strong feel for what makes content engaging and a creator credible, beyond follower counts alone.

• Excellent written English and the ability to tailor a message to the person receiving it.

• Strong organisation, attention to detail and comfort managing multiple conversations at once.

• Confidence using spreadsheets or similar tracking tools, and the initiative to work independently while collaborating with a team.

• Availability to overlap with our Australian team during the working week.



Why join us

You'll work closely with an experienced influencer manager, contribute to campaigns for great brands and have room to bring your own creator discoveries and ideas to the table. This is a full-time role for someone who wants to build their career in social and creator marketing.



To apply, tell us briefly about your social or creator outreach experience. Include one or two examples of creators or campaigns you've researched or supported (you can keep client details confidential), the platforms you follow most closely, your expected monthly salary and your availability to start.

title: Agency Project Manager (ClickUp Focus)- Remote Philippines
description:
We are a Sydney-based creative agency looking for a highly organised Agency Project Manager to coordinate delivery across client service, creative, social, influencer, digital and production.



This role is for someone who can create order quickly and keep work moving. You will turn briefs, meetings and conversations into clear project plans, follow actions through to completion and make sure the team knows what is due, what is missing, what is blocked and what needs a decision.



You will own the day-to-day coordination of agreed projects, from brief and kickoff through to delivery and wrap-up. Success means reliable project visibility, fewer missed handovers and less chasing by senior team members.



You will work closely with our Head of Client Service & Operations, Senior Account Directors and creative team. The Head of Client Service & Operations will be your primary escalation point for competing priorities and delivery issues. Account leads will retain responsibility for client relationships, strategy and commercial decisions, and creative leads will retain responsibility for creative quality and approval.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build and manage ClickUp project plans from agreed briefs, with clear deliverables, named owners, realistic deadlines, milestones, dependencies and approval steps.

- Check that briefs and handovers contain the information needed to start work, and follow up on missing information before it causes delays.

- Keep ClickUp as the agreed source of delivery status. Capture actions and decisions from Slack, meetings and campaign documents, with links to the relevant files.

- Prepare and coordinate internal work-in-progress meetings, record decisions and follow actions through to completion.

- Follow up professionally and persistently with team members, including senior staff, on agreed commitments.

- Track assets, feedback, revisions and approvals. Check that deliverables are complete, use the correct versions and specifications, and have the required approvals recorded.

- Coordinate handovers between account service, creative, social, influencer, digital, production and external suppliers where required.

- Identify competing deadlines and check team availability before confirming timings. Flag capacity constraints to the operations lead.

- Flag scope changes, extra deliverables and additional revision rounds to the account lead before they become unplanned work.

- Escalate risks and blockers early, explaining the impact, the decision needed and your recommended next step.

- Prepare concise weekly status updates showing milestones, owners, risks and decisions required. Escalate urgent issues as they arise.

- Coordinate launch-readiness checks and post-campaign wrap-up, including final assets, outstanding actions and handover to reporting or finance owners.

- Improve practical ClickUp templates, views, dashboards and workflows so they are consistent and useful for the team.



ABOUT YOU



- You have experience managing multiple projects in a creative agency, marketing team or similar delivery environment.

- You can turn messy information into a clear, workable plan and keep that plan current.

- You are proactive and comfortable asking questions, following up with senior people and escalating problems respectfully.

- You understand campaign timelines, creative production, approvals, dependencies and handovers.

- You can distinguish a status update from a problem that needs a decision, and suggest a practical next step.

- You have hands-on ClickUp experience, including setting up and maintaining project plans, templates, views or dashboards.

- You write clearly and professionally in English and have strong attention to detail without becoming slow.

- You can work independently while staying closely connected to an Australian team.



TOOLS



ClickUp, Slack and Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Slides.



Familiarity with Canva or Adobe production workflows is useful but not essential.



The focus of this role is project coordination and delivery. Specialist team members will handle paid media buying, social media management, creator sourcing, design and strategy.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Remote role based in the Philippines.

- Full-time, 38 hours per week.

- USD $1,300-$1,900 per month, depending on experience.

- Regular weekday overlap with Australia/Sydney business hours is required. A consistent working schedule will be agreed before starting, taking Sydney daylight saving into account.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:

1. A brief example of a campaign or project that started slipping: what was going wrong, what you personally did and what happened.

2. An example of a ClickUp project plan, template, view, dashboard or workflow you have built or improved. You can describe it or share an anonymised screenshot; please do not share confidential client information.

3. Your availability, earliest start date and the hours you can overlap with Australia/Sydney.



Applications that do not address these points will not be reviewed.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: Part-time appointment setter, US business calls (deck builders), 20 hrs/week
description:
About the job

I run Deck Quote Now, a small US software product for deck-building companies: an instant quote button for their websites. You will call deck-building businesses in the United States (business phone numbers, owners or office staff) and do one thing: get them to agree to a 2-minute demo call with me, or to receive the demo link by text or
.



You are not closing sales and you do not handle money. You work from a daily call sheet I provide (company, name, number, notes) and log the outcome of every call on a simple web page I give you.



You need

- Clear, confident English with a calm phone manner. US business owners are blunt; you need to be relaxed and friendly, not scripted-sounding.

- At least 1 year of outbound calling or appointment setting for US clients.

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to call. I provide the US phone line.



Daily routine

- 9:00 AM US Central: open the sheet, 30-50 numbers, dial by hand (no autodialers).

- Log every call: no answer / voi
 / not interested / send info / booked.

- Anyone who says "don't call" goes on a do-not-call list and is never called again.

- End of shift: 3-line summary to me.



Pay: $5-7/hour depending on experience, paid weekly. Bonus $10 for every booked call that turns into a sale.



To apply, reply with:

1. One paragraph about your calling experience (what you sold or booked, for whom).

2. A 30-second voice recording (Vocaroo link is fine) reading this: "Hey, this is [name] calling for Martin at Deck Quote Now. Martin builds decks in New York and put together a two-minute demo of an instant quote button for your website. He'd like to show it to you himself. Is this morning or this afternoon better for a quick call?"

3. Your hours available in US Central time.



Start: this week.

title: Virtual Mental Health Administrative Assistant
description:
PLEASE SEND A VIDEO WITH YOUR RESUME



About the role

The Alchemy Institute is a virtual psychiatric practice serving patients across North Carolina, with five psychiatric providers and a small remote admin team. We're hiring an Afternoon Practice Coordinator to be available from 12:00 to 5:00 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday, picking up from our morning coordinator. This is mainly task based, meaning the hours are reflected in amount of time spend on any work related tasks. 



This is a judgment role, not a task queue. You'll be the person patients and providers reach in the afternoon, and you'll be expected to solve problems, follow our protocols, and know when something needs a clinician. The owner is often offline during these hours, so the practice needs to run smoothly without her.



What success looks like after 90 days:

• Patients get a same-afternoon response, and nothing waits until the next day without a reason.

• Provider questions are answered, routed to the on-call provider, or batched for the owner, never left hanging.

• Billing questions and patient balances are explained clearly and accurately.

• The owner can log off on her non-clinical days without checking in.



How to apply: Along with your résumé, submit a 2–3 minute video of yourself answering these questions out loud: (1) Tell us about your experience in a healthcare office. (2) A patient calls upset about a bill they don't understand. Show us how you'd respond to them. Applications without a video won't be reviewed.



Responsibilities



Patient communication

• Answer patient calls, voi
s, portal messages and
s in the shared inbox throughout the afternoon.

• Schedule, reschedule and confirm appointments in the EHR; manage cancellations and the waitlist.

• Recognize when a patient message needs a clinician (safety concerns, medication problems, worsening symptoms) and route it the same day per our escalation guide.

• Communicate with patients warmly and professionally, with a working understanding of mental health and how to talk with people who are struggling.



Provider support

• Be the first stop for the five providers' afternoon questions: scheduling, patient logistics, forms, records and documents.

• Route clinical questions to the provider on call, and batch owner-level questions into one daily summary instead of interrupting her.

• Handle records requests, referral paperwork and outgoing referrals.



Billing and claims

• Read and explain a patient's ledger, invoice and statement in the EHR: charges, payments, insurance adjustments and balances.

• Answer patient billing questions and collect or set up payment for balances.

• Spot common claim problems (eligibility, wrong insurance on file, missing authorizations) and hand them to the biller with clear notes.

• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits for new and returning patients.

Prior authorizations (trainable, lower priority)

• Submit and track prior authorizations for psychiatric medications through CoverMyMeds and payer portals, and follow up until resolved.



Handoffs and reliability

• Take the morning handoff from the morning coordinator at 12:00, and leave a clear end-of-day note at 5:00.

• Follow written protocols, and help improve them when something isn't covered.

• Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA in every communication.



Requirements



Must have

• At least 1 year of admin experience in a healthcare practice, ideally mental or behavioral health.

• Working knowledge of medical billing: reading claims, EOBs and patient ledgers, and explaining a balance to a patient.

• Experience using an EHR (TherapyNotes a plus) and verifying insurance eligibility.

• Sound judgment: you can tell routine from urgent and act without being told every step.

• Fluent, clearly understood spoken and written English. Patients and providers must be able to understand you easily by phone, including patients who are distressed. Your video submission is how we assess this.

• Reliable availability 12:00–5:00 PM Eastern, Monday–Friday, with a stable internet connection.

• Understanding of patient privacy and HIPAA.



Nice to have

• Prior authorization experience with psychiatric medications (CoverMyMeds or payer portals). We'll train this.

• Familiarity with North Carolina payers (BCBS NC, Medicaid plans, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare/Optum).

• Experience supporting several providers at once.

title: Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist
description:
Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist



Remote — Philippines | Lyons Cards LLC



ABOUT LYONS CARDS



Lyons Cards LLC is a fast-growing, family-owned sports-card and live-commerce company based in St. Louis, Missouri.



We are building a modern sports-card business around:



* Live breaks

* Premium singles

* PSA/BGS/SGC graded cards

* Sealed sports-card products

* Repacks

* Shopify / 

* Whatnot live commerce

* Online marketplace sales

* Customer engagement

* Strategic inventory management



Our primary sports are football and basketball, with select baseball inventory.



We are looking for a highly capable Philippines-based team member who can help us turn inventory into revenue while keeping our online listings, customer inquiries and card inventory organized.



⸻



POSITION



Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist



This is not simply a data-entry job.



This person will help Lyons Cards with:



CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT + SALES + INVENTORY + LISTINGS + MARKETPLACE SUPPORT



The ideal person is extremely organized, fast, commercially minded, comfortable learning new software, and able to communicate with U.S. customers at a very high level.



⸻



ENGLISH REQUIREMENT — C2 MASTERY



C2-level English mastery is required.



You must be able to:



* Write naturally to U.S. customers

* Understand casual American English and slang

* Respond professionally without sounding scripted

* Handle negotiations

* Understand detailed instructions

* Recognize when a customer is serious versus simply asking questions

* Escalate unusual situations clearly

* Communicate confidently with management



Your written English should be nearly indistinguishable from that of a highly proficient native-level business communicator.



Please do not apply if your English level is below C2/near-native professional proficiency.



⸻



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CUSTOMER / MARKETPLACE SALES SUPPORT



Monitor and respond to customer inquiries across approved Lyons Cards channels.



These may include:



* 
 / Shopify

*

* Whatnot

* eBay

* Other approved marketplace channels

* Customer email

* Social comments and direct messages



Responsibilities include:



* Answering product questions

* Responding to comments

* Responding to pricing inquiries

* Handling offers

* Following up with interested customers

* Helping convert inquiries into sales

* Providing basic shipping/order information

* Maintaining a professional Lyons Cards voice



The objective is not simply to answer messages.



The objective is to help produce sales.



⸻



2. OFFER / NEGOTIATION MANAGEMENT



Lyons Cards will establish pricing and negotiation guidelines.



You will be expected to:



* Know the current asking price

* Understand approved negotiation ranges

* Respond to reasonable offers

* Recognize serious buyers

* Avoid unnecessarily discounting inventory

* Escalate offers that fall outside your approved authority



Example:



If a card is listed at $500 and an offer falls within an approved range, you may be authorized to continue the negotiation.



If an offer falls below the approved range or involves an important card, immediately send the offer to Connor Lyons for a decision.



Do not guess.



Do not make unauthorized discounts.



⸻



3. CARD INVENTORY INTAKE



A major responsibility will be helping Lyons Cards rapidly load inventory into Card Dealer Pro, our inventory management system.



We are intentionally simplifying this process.



The goal is:



GET THE CARD INTO THE SYSTEM QUICKLY AND ACCURATELY.



You may receive batches of card photographs from Connor or another Lyons Cards team member.



Example:



Connor sends you 20–50 card photographs and basic instructions.



You then create/import the batch and make sure those cards are properly entered into inventory.



⸻



4. TWO PRIMARY INVENTORY BATCHES



Inventory will generally begin in two major categories:



GRADED / SLABS



Examples:



* PSA

* BGS / Beckett

* SGC

* Other approved grading companies



Important information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Grading company

* Grade

* Certification number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Selling price

* Status



RAW CARDS



Raw cards are cards that have not been professionally graded.



Information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Selling price

* Status



We do NOT want unnecessary data entry that slows down the operation.



Accuracy and speed are both important.



⸻



5. INVENTORY STATUS / USE



Cards may be assigned different jobs inside the company.



Examples:



AVAILABLE

Normal inventory available to sell.



HOLD

Do not sell without management approval.



REPACK

Reserved or considered for Lyons Cards repack products.



GRADE

Raw card intended for professional grading.



REVIEW

Management decision required.



You must make sure special inventory is not a
 sold.



⸻



6. PRICING SUPPORT



Market value — not historical purchase cost — drives our selling decisions.



Management will establish pricing using current card-market information and revenue-management principles.



You may be given a price directly by Connor or management.



Example:



Connor sends:



Card photos + $349 list price + AVAILABLE



Your responsibility is to enter the cards correctly and make sure the correct selling price/status appears in the system.



As you develop, you may assist with basic market research and comparable sales.



Final pricing authority remains with Lyons Cards management unless otherwise delegated.



⸻



7. SHOPIFY / E-COMMERCE SUPPORT



Card Dealer Pro is the primary inventory system.



Shopify / 
 is the consumer storefront.



You may help:



* Review products before they go live

* Verify images

* Verify titles

* Verify pricing

* Confirm availability

* Correct listing errors

* Organize collections

* Monitor customer inquiries

* Identify products that need updated pricing

* Ensure sold inventory is properly handled across channels



You should become comfortable working inside modern e-commerce software.



⸻



8. WHATNOT / LIVE-COMMERCE SUPPORT



Lyons Cards is building a significant live-commerce business on Whatnot.



You may assist with:



* Show listings

* Product setup

* Customer messages

* Auction preparation

* Post-show order review

* Buyer questions

* Sales follow-up

* Analytics

* Inventory reconciliation



You will not automatically be responsible for hosting shows.



Your job is to help the hosts and management operate efficiently behind the scenes.



⸻



9. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE



Lyons Cards is built around a simple principle:



WE ARE NOT TRYING TO WIN ONE TRANSACTION.



WE ARE TRYING TO WIN THE CUSTOMER.



We expect:



* Fast responses

* Professional communication

* Honest descriptions

* No misleading claims

* No aggressive pressure

* No unauthorized discounts

* Strong follow-up

* Respect for collectors

* Immediate escalation when something appears wrong



Customers should feel that Lyons Cards is organized, responsive and trustworthy.



⸻



10. SOFTWARE / SYSTEMS



You should be comfortable learning and using systems such as:



* Card Dealer Pro

* Shopify

* Whatnot Seller Hub

* eBay

* Google Sheets

* Google Drive

* Email

* Messaging platforms

* Basic image/file management

* Marketplace dashboards



Training will be provided on Lyons Cards-specific processes.



You must be comfortable learning technology quickly.

* C2 / near-native English proficiency — REQUIRED

* Excellent written communication

* Strong attention to detail

* Fast computer skills

* Comfortable working with large numbers of images/files

* Strong organizational ability

* Reliable internet connection

* Ability to follow pricing/negotiation rules

* Strong judgment

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to recognize when management approval is required

* Comfortable learning new software

* Reliable and responsive

* Commercial/sales mindset



⸻



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



* Sports cards

* Trading cards

* Whatnot

* eBay

* Shopify

* Online selling

* Marketplace customer service
