title: Operations Lead — U.S. Lawn Care Company
description:
We're a growing residential lawn care company in the U.S. (fertilization, weed control, lawn mowing and landscaping), and we're looking for the person who runs the show behind the scenes — a real operations person, not an admin assistant. If chaos calms down when you log in, keep reading



What you'll own:



*Managing and training the other VAs in the office



*Assigning daily tasks to the VA team and tracking where the hours go — yours included — so we always know what our time is producing



*Weekly reports — churn, revenue vs. schedule, overtime, past-dues — and telling the owner what the numbers actually mean



*Running a weekly meeting rhythm — leading the VA team meeting and a weekly report/review with the owner, with agendas and action items that actually get followed up



*Preparing payroll and reviewing timecards



*Supporting hiring — posting ads, screening, scheduling interviews, onboarding



*Workforce planning — seeing the busy season coming and telling the owner how many people we'll need before we're short



*Sales tracking and coaching — setting goals, monitoring estimates, follow-ups, and conversion rates, and training the VAs to sell and upsell on calls



*Daily dispatch and routing for multiple crews — and reworking the schedule same-day when weather or call-outs hit



*Scheduling recurring services, skips, cancellations, reschedules



*Customer issue resolution — complaints, service recalls, keeping clients from cancelling



*Reviewing time-on-site and job profitability — catching jobs that run long or are priced wrong



*Invoicing, past-due follow-up, and collections



*Implementing annual price increases — identifying which customers are due, updating their pricing, and notifying them



*Tracking supplies and inventory, reordering before we run out, and keeping receipts/expenses organized for clean job costing



*Managing automations and service notifications in our software — and troubleshooting with the software provider when something breaks



*Writing SOPs so nothing lives in one person's head



*Winter projects — reviewing the year's numbers and setting goals and targets with the owner for the year ahead



*Helping build what's next as we grow — automations, dashboards, better systems, and bringing your own ideas to improve the business once you know how we run. We want someone who suggests things, not just waits for instructions.



The goal is simple: you run the backend so the owner can focus on growing the business. (Still reading? Good — start the first line of your application with the word "SHARP" so we know you read the whole post.)



Requirements:



*2+ years running operations/dispatch for a home service company (lawn care, pest, cleaning, HVAC, plumbing)



*Direct lawn care or weed control industry experience is a huge plus



*Field service software experience — Service Autopilot a big plus (ServiceTitan, Real Green, Jobber, Housecall Pro similar)



*Experience with EOS/Traction or 
 is a plus



*Strong with reports and spreadsheets — you can pull data and tell me what it means



*Strong written and spoken English; comfortable on client calls



*Fast communicator — you acknowledge messages same day, even if the answer is "working on it"



*Dual monitors, fast internet, quiet workspace



*Available 30–40 hours/week depending on season, during U.S. Central business hours — exact schedule discussed at interview



Pay: $6–9/hr depending on experience.



How to apply: answer these in a 5-10 minute video:



1. Biggest operation you've run — how many crews/techs and roughly how much revenue per week?



2. One problem you caught before your boss did.



3. How do you plan ahead — walk me through how you'd look 2 weeks to a month out to keep crews full and overtime down.



4. Have you managed other VAs before? If so, how many and what did you train them on?



5. Show us your monitors and workstation on camera, and give us one reason we'd be crazy not to hire you.



6. Send 1–2 examples of reports, scorecards, or dashboards you've built (blur out the company's private info — we just want to see how you work with numbers). If you've used EOS or 
, tell us where and how.



Video requirements: record a NEW video for this application — answer the questions above in it. Make sure the link is open-access (no permission requests). Don't send a Loom or a recycled video that's been viewed 10+ times — those will not be considered.



Applications that skip the video, the questions, or the word get deleted. (We mean it. This job is literally about following through on details.)

title: Senior Finance Officer: Payroll, Payables and Receivables (Xero, Australian business group, USD 11 to 13/hr)
description:
We're part of a group of about 40 family-run Australian businesses, based on the far south coast of New South Wales: hardware and building supplies, window manufacturing, civil construction, quarries and logistics.



We're setting up a new entity to support these businesses through a remote team, and this is one of the first roles. We're looking for one experienced finance professional to run payroll and accounts, working directly for us and reporting to our Finance Manager. You start with our hardware business and take on more businesses as you go.



ROOM TO GROW

With 40 businesses in the group and a remote team being built around them, there are genuine opportunities for the right person to grow, including helping to manage other remote team members in future.



THE WORK

- Payroll in Xero Payroll for about 35 staff: pay runs, super, STP, leave and final pays

- Supplier bills in Xero, the weekly payment run and supplier reconciliations

- Customer invoicing, receipts and statements, and phoning customers about overdue accounts

- Bank reconciliations and month-end support

- Using AI tools every day, and helping us improve the flow between our Striven point-of-sale system and Xero



WHAT WE NEED

- At least 4 years of hands-on Australian bookkeeping and payroll, done by you personally

- Xero and Xero Payroll, across more than one business or file

- End-to-end Australian payroll, including STP, super, leave and award interpretation

- Clear, confident spoken English. You'll speak with our suppliers, customers and managers by phone and Teams

- Full time, Sydney business hours

- A reliable connection with backup, a quiet workspace and a headset



Well regarded: a CPA or accounting qualification, retail, hardware or manufacturing clients, and point-of-sale systems.



Please note: this role is for one person working directly with us. We're not engaging firms or teams.



PAY

USD 11 to 13 an hour, full time, depending on experience. Three-month initial period.



THE PROCESS IS QUICK

Applications close midnight Wednesday 11 November, Sydney time. Shortlisted applicants do a paid skills test and a short video on Thursday and Friday, with final interviews on Monday 16 November.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE THREE QUESTIONS IN YOUR APPLICATION

1. Tell us about a real time you found a payroll or accounts error before it was paid. What was it, and what did you do?

2. How many businesses or Xero files do you currently manage, and roughly how many employees and supplier bills each pay cycle?

3. Describe a difficult phone call with a supplier or customer, and how you handled it.



Applications that don't answer all three will not be considered.

**2. QuickBooks & Accounting**



- Set up or clean up QuickBooks Online, as appropriate.

- Establish a practical chart of accounts.

- Import and categorize transactions.

- Reconcile accounts to supporting statements.

- Prepare profit-and-loss statements.

- Prepare balance sheets where applicable.

- Produce income and expense summaries.

- Maintain organized supporting documentation.



**3. Tax Preparation Support**



- Prepare clean financial reports for a U.S. tax professional.

- Identify potentially deductible business expenses for professional review.

- Separate different categories of service income.

- Organize documents needed for tax filing.

- Coordinate with a U.S. tax accountant when necessary.

- Maintain clear records of assumptions and unresolved issues.



You are not expected to independently determine complex U.S. tax treatment or provide legal or tax advice.



**4. Ongoing Bookkeeping**



If the initial project is successful, responsibilities may expand to monthly bookkeeping, financial reporting, contractor payment tracking, and accounting support for a growing digital business.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong hands-on QuickBooks Online experience.

- Demonstrated bank and credit-card reconciliation experience.

- Experience cleaning up incomplete or disorganized accounting records.

- Ability to prepare accurate financial statements.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Experience working with U.S. businesses or U.S. accounting practices.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Clear written English communication.

- Ability to work independently and identify problems without constant supervision.



## Preferred Qualifications



- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.

- Accounting degree or equivalent professional training.

- Experience preparing books for U.S. tax accountants.

- Familiarity with sole proprietorships and Schedule C accounting.

- Experience with multiple business activities.

- Experience with historical bookkeeping reconstruction.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted accounting workflows, with appropriate data security.



## Ideal Candidate



I value someone who is accurate, organized, resourceful, and proactive.



You should be comfortable working with imperfect financial records, identifying missing information, and asking intelligent questions.



I am not looking for someone who simply categorizes transactions without understanding the underlying accounting.



**Your goal is to deliver clean, reconciled, reliable books—not merely complete a list of tasks.**



## Initial Project



The first engagement will focus on reconstructing 2026 financial records.



Expected deliverables include:



- Reconciled financial records.

- Organized transaction classifications.

- Separate income and expense reports by business activity.

- Preliminary financial statements.

- A list of missing information and unresolved issues.

- A tax-accountant-ready financial package.

- Recommendations for maintaining accurate records going forward.



The initial engagement will be paid and scoped according to the volume and condition of the records.



Long-term opportunities may be available based on performance.



## Application Instructions — Read Carefully



To demonstrate that you have read the complete posting, begin your application with the exact heading:



**Bookkeeping Cleanup — Application**



Then provide:



1. Your résumé and a brief summary of your bookkeeping experience.

2. Your QuickBooks Online experience and any certifications.

3. One example of a bookkeeping cleanup or financial reconstruction project you personally completed.

4. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

5. Your experience preparing financial records for U.S. tax accountants.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer in approximately 100–150 words:



*A U.S. sole proprietor has three business activities, several bank accounts, mixed personal and business transactions, and incomplete bookkeeping records for 2026.*



**What are the first five steps you would take to reconstruct accurate financial records, and how would you verify the results?**



We are evaluating your practical accounting knowledge, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You may include a short 2–3 minute video introducing yourself, explaining your bookkeeping experience, and describing a cleanup project you personally completed.



A simple recording is sufficient. Video is preferred but not required; written responses are equally acceptable.



## Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short, paid practical assessment using fictional financial data.



The assessment may involve transaction categorization, reconciliation, identifying discrepancies, and preparing a basic financial report.



Please do not submit confidential client financial records.



We are looking for a dependable professional who can establish accurate books and help build a reliable long-term accounting system.

title: U.S. Tax Accountant – Tax Preparation & Planning
description:
# U.S. Tax Accountant / Tax Preparation Specialist



**Location:** Philippines — Remote  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Project-Based  

**Compensation:** $4-$8 USD/hour, depending on experience and qualifications  

**Initial Workload:** Approximately 5–15 hours per week, depending on project needs  

**Start:** As soon as practical



## About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur seeking an experienced U.S. tax accountant to help establish my current tax position, identify legitimate tax-planning opportunities, and prepare accurate tax documentation.



My business activities currently operate primarily as sole proprietorships, and I am developing a scalable digital lead-generation business.



I need someone with genuine hands-on U.S. federal tax experience who can work with organized financial records, identify missing information, prepare tax projections, and support compliance and planning decisions.



**This is a technical U.S. tax accounting position—not a general bookkeeping or virtual assistant role.**



I may also engage specialized U.S. tax and legal professionals for matters requiring additional expertise.



## Primary Responsibilities



**1. U.S. Individual & Small-Business Tax Accounting**



- Review financial records and supporting documentation.

- Assist with Form 1040 and Schedule C tax preparation.

- Calculate or support self-employment tax projections.

- Identify potential business deductions and applicable limitations.

- Review income and expense classifications.

- Prepare tax workpapers and supporting schedules.

- Assist with federal and California tax calculations.

- Identify missing documentation and potential compliance issues.



**2. Tax Projections & Year-End Planning**



- Prepare preliminary current-year federal and state tax projections.

- Compare tax outcomes under different legitimate planning scenarios.

- Evaluate estimated tax payments and relevant deadlines.

- Identify available deductions and retirement contribution opportunities.

- Analyze the potential tax impact of planned business expenditures.

- Prepare concise summaries of findings and recommendations.



All conclusions must be supported by applicable rules, documented assumptions, and appropriate professional review.



**3. Retirement & Business Tax Research**



Assist with research and preliminary analysis involving:



- Solo 401(k) contributions.

- Traditional and Roth retirement accounts.

- Self-employment tax.

- Qualified business income deductions.

- Business depreciation.

- S-Corp and C-Corp taxation.

- Entity elections and transitions.

- Other relevant small-business tax strategies.



Specialized arrangements such as ROBS, complex trusts, and international structures may require outside experts.



You are not expected to independently provide legal opinions or specialized advice beyond your qualifications.



**4. Tax Compliance & Professional Coordination**



- Organize tax documentation for filing.

- Help determine which previous tax years require review.

- Coordinate with bookkeepers and outside tax professionals.

- Prepare questions for specialist consultations.

- Maintain a list of unresolved tax issues.

- Track tax-related deadlines and documentation requirements.

- Support implementation of professionally reviewed recommendations.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation experience.

- Experience preparing Form 1040 and Schedule C returns.

- Experience with U.S. business tax returns or related workpapers.

- Strong understanding of U.S. individual and small-business taxation.

- Ability to calculate or prepare tax projections.

- Familiarity with self-employment tax and business deductions.

- Experience using professional U.S. tax preparation software.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to research tax questions using authoritative sources.

- Clear written English communication.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Active IRS Enrolled Agent or U.S. CPA credential.

- Philippine CPA qualification with substantial U.S. tax experience.

- Experience working for a U.S. CPA firm.

- Experience with California individual and small-business tax returns.

- Familiarity with retirement contribution calculations.

- Experience with Forms 1120-S, 1065, or 1120.

- Experience supporting tax-planning engagements.

- Familiarity with QuickBooks Online.

- Experience communicating directly with U.S. clients.



Please identify the jurisdiction and current status of any professional credentials.



## Ideal Candidate



I am looking for someone who understands tax rules rather than merely entering information into tax software.



You should be capable of:



- Identifying missing facts before calculating tax liabilities.

- Recognizing potentially valuable deductions.

- Explaining tax-planning alternatives.

- Supporting conclusions with reliable sources.

- Recognizing when specialized advice is required.

- Communicating technical issues clearly.

- Working independently without overstating your expertise.



**Accuracy, professional judgment, and intellectual honesty are essential.**



## Initial Project



The first engagement will focus on establishing my current tax position and preparing for year-end planning and filing.



Expected deliverables include:



- Preliminary federal and California tax projections.

- Identification of missing information.

- Review of potential deductions.

- Retirement contribution calculations where applicable.

- Review of estimated tax obligations.

- Identification of prior-year filing questions.

- A prioritized tax-action checklist.

- Organized documentation for tax return preparation and professional review.



The scope and deadlines will be established at the beginning of the engagement.



Successful candidates may be considered for recurring tax accounting and compliance support.



## Application Instructions — Read Carefully



To demonstrate that you have reviewed the complete posting, begin your application with the exact heading:



**U.S. Tax Accounting — Application**



Then provide:



1. Your résumé and years of hands-on U.S. tax experience.

2. The U.S. tax forms you have personally prepared or reviewed.

3. The tax software you have used professionally.

4. One example of a tax-planning calculation or analysis you personally completed.

5. Your credentials, hourly rate, and weekly availability.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer in approximately 100–150 words:



*A California sole proprietor reports approximately $140,000 in annual business income and has no existing retirement accounts. The owner wants to reduce current-year taxes while preserving cash for a growing business.*



**What information would you request before calculating the owner's tax liability, and which three tax-planning opportunities would you investigate first?**



We are evaluating technical understanding, analytical reasoning, and recognition of missing information—not promises of a particular tax outcome.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You may include a short 2–3 minute video introducing yourself, describing your U.S. tax experience, and explaining a tax calculation or planning project you personally completed.



A simple recording is sufficient. Video is preferred but not required; equivalent written responses are welcome.



## Selection Process



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete a paid practical assessment using fictional tax and financial data.



The assessment may include reviewing a sample Schedule C, preparing a basic tax projection, identifying missing information, and researching a technical tax question.



Applicants should not submit confidential client tax records.



We are looking for a technically capable professional who can help establish accurate tax information and support sound financial decisions.

description:
ABOUT THE POSITION



We’re seeking an experienced video editor with strong creative judgment, attention to detail, and reliable communication.



You should understand storytelling, pacing, viewer retention, B-roll, motion text, graphics, music, and professional audio.



We’ll begin with a 100-day trial agreement to establish production processes and determine whether the working relationship is suitable for a potential long-term position.



EXPERIENCE AND EDITING SKILLS



We’re looking for:



Preferably four or more years of professional editing experience.



Strong complete long-form video examples and short-form work.



Experience with educational, talking-head, coaching, fitness, wellness, or personal-brand content.



Strong openings, thoughtful pacing, relevant B-roll, and readable graphics.



Clear dialogue, balanced music, accurate captions, and polished finishing.



Strong English comprehension and communication.



Independent problem-solving, realistic estimates, and reliable follow-through.



Be highly proficient in one or more of these editing platforms: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or Descript.



After Effects and motion graphics experience are a plus.



QUALITY CONTROL, REVISIONS, AND COMMUNICATION



Watch and listen to your videos before submitting. Check audio, spelling, captions, graphics, framing, transitions, and export quality.



Revisions are part of the job. You must be willing to make as many revisions as necessary to meet the agreed brief and approved creative direction.



Read feedback carefully, ask questions when needed, implement corrections accurately, and review your work before resubmitting.



Acknowledge direct messages within two hours during your agreed working periods. Messages received outside those periods can be acknowledged when your next scheduled work period begins.



Provide progress updates and promptly flag problems that could affect delivery.



COMPENSATION AND TRIAL



Pay is $6 USD per hour, with approximately 10 hours per week or less, depending on production needs. A 10-hour week totals $60.



Include editing, revisions, quality control, and delivery in your time planning.



Some weeks may require additional revision hours. Additional hours must be agreed upon and authorized in advance and are paid at $6 USD per hour. Do not exceed authorized hours without approval.



During the 100-day trial, we’ll evaluate editing quality, communication, reliability, efficiency, feedback implementation, and file management.



PROJECT FILES AND DELIVERY



You must provide:



Final exports in the agreed format and resolution.



Editable project files and associated assets.



Clearly named, organized files in our company-controlled Google Drive system.



Use appropriately licensed assets and disclose any licensing restrictions.



PAID EDITING TEST



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid production test.



Scope, authorized hours, compensation, deadline, creative checkpoint, and delivery requirements will be agreed upon before work begins.



We’ll evaluate editing quality, creative judgment, accuracy, communication, revision implementation, and project handoff.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph messages only. Do not
 the address associated with this account.



Subject line: Years Younger Video Editor



Use exactly the number of Apply Points represented by this equation:



(5 × 5) − 20 = ?



Include the word unicorn somewhere in your written application.



Answer these six questions:



PORTFOLIO



Provide direct Google Drive links to four actual video files:



Two complete long-form videos you personally edited.



Two Shorts or vertical videos you personally edited.



Only Google Drive links are accepted. Do not substitute YouTube, Vimeo, Canva, portfolio websites, or other external links.



A published video link alone does not establish who edited it.



Long-form examples must be complete videos, not reels, trailers, or shortened previews. Share only work you have permission to provide.



EQUIPMENT AND INTERNET



List:



Computer make and model.



Processor, RAM, and graphics card or Apple chip.



Storage type and available storage space.



Operating system and primary editing software.



Current download and upload speeds in Mbps on the connection you’ll use.



Backup arrangements for internet or power interruptions, if any.



Include a Google Drive link to a recent speed-test screenshot showing the test date and results.



EXPERIENCE AND CREATIVE JUDGMENT



How many years have you edited professionally?



Choose one portfolio example and provide a timestamp for an editing decision you’re proud of. Explain what you did and why.



Briefly describe how you use pacing, B-roll, text, and music to improve educational videos without distracting from the content.



AVAILABILITY AND PAY



Confirm:



That $6 USD per hour works for you.



That a workload of approximately 10 hours per week or less works for you.



That you’re comfortable with an initial 100-day trial.



Your availability and earliest start date.

Whether you have flexibility for additional paid hours when agreed upon in advance.



QUALITY CONTROL AND FEEDBACK



How do you check a finished video and track revision requests?



Give a brief example of how you handled feedback requiring substantial changes.



Confirm that you’re willing to revise work as necessary to meet the agreed brief and communicate before exceeding authorized hours.



PROJECT HANDOFF

MANDATORY LINK CHECK



Before applying, double-check every Google Drive link:

Applications with broken, restricted, incorrect, or unplayable links will be disqualified. Applications that substitute other platforms for the required Google Drive links will also be disqualified.

Kerri

title: DM Setter & Closer (Full-Cycle, Commission-Based)
description:
About Elnez

Elnez is a performance-based UGC and content distribution platform. We turn long-form content into high-impact short-form clips and distribute them across TikTok, Reels, Shorts and X to reach millions of viewers and drive measurable results for creators and brands. Our campaigns run from $3,000 to $10,000+.

We focus on data-driven content performance, creative optimization and streamlined workflows. If you're passionate about short-form content, social media growth and the creator economy, you'll fit in here.

The Role

You own the full sales cycle: start the conversation, book the call, run it, and close the deal. This is not a booking-only role.

Manage high volumes of outbound and inbound Instagram DMs to start conversations with brands, creators and partners.

Qualify prospects and book discovery calls with the right ones.

Run discovery and closing calls on Zoom: uncover the prospect's goals, present the right campaign, handle objections and close.

Collect payment and hand new clients over to the onboarding team.

Follow our scripts and frameworks while personalizing every conversation.

Keep the CRM accurate: every conversation, lead status and call outcome logged.

Report on your pipeline and results, and refine your messaging based on feedback and data.

Work with sales, marketing and operations to keep messaging aligned.

Compensation

Commission-only, uncapped.

12% commission on every campaign you close (3,000–9,999).

15% commission on campaigns of $10,000 and above.

5% commission on repeat campaigns from brands you closed, for 6 months after the first deal.

Commission is paid on cash collected, after the client's payment clears.

Commission is reversed if a client refunds or charges back within 30 days.

What that looks like: a $3,000 campaign pays $360. A $10,000 campaign pays $1,500. Closing 12 campaigns a month at a $5,000 average earns $7,200; 20 campaigns earns $12,000+, before repeat business.

KPIs & Expectations

Full target: 6-12 closed campaigns per month.

Month one: 3-6 closed campaigns (50% of the full target) by day 30. This is the bar to continue in the role.

Hit agreed show-rate and close-rate targets once ramped.

Submit an end-of-day report every working day.

Record every sales call.

Keep the CRM up to date in real time.

Attend the weekly sales team meeting.

Report to the Director.

Requirements

A proven closing track record. Be ready to share your close rate, cash collected and average deal size.

Call recordings or references from previous closing or setting roles.

Experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting and closing high-ticket offers.

Experience managing social media DMs at volume.

An Instagram account with 600+ followers and a clean, optimized profile that looks authentic.

Strong written and spoken English: clear, concise and professional.

Comfortable following structured scripts and workflows while adapting to each prospect.

Comfortable with CRM and tracking tools.

Highly organized, detail-oriented and reliable.

Available during campaign windows and able to respond promptly.

Strong advantage: experience selling to brands, agencies or marketing services, or familiarity with clipping, UGC, the creator economy or digital marketing.

Who Wins in This Role

Self-driven and comfortable with commission-only pay.

Coachable: takes feedback and applies it the same week.

Competitive and numbers-focused.

Professional, respectful and committed to non-discriminatory practices with diverse audiences and colleagues.

Onboarding & Support

We invest in getting you to target fast.

Days 1–3: Onboarding materials: our ideal client profile, campaign offers and pricing, sales script, FAQ and objection guide, and recordings of closed deals.

Days 4–5: Shadow live sales calls.

Week 2: Start taking your own calls.

First 30 days: A daily 30-minute one-on-one for call review, role-play and coaching.

Hiring Process

Apply with your closing numbers and Instagram handle.

Group interview with shortlisted candidates.

One-on-one interview, including a mock call using the script we send you in advance.

Offer.

How to Apply

Fill this form

title: GoHighLevel VA – Outbound Calling, Client Follow-Up & Pipelines (US Real Estate)
description:
Up Close Inspections is a growing property inspection company in Cleveland, Ohio. We work with US homebuyers, real estate agents, and loan officers. The advertised rate is $8.50 per hour. This is a part-time, long-term independent contractor role. Assigned shifts are scheduled within Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET). We will provide your exact schedule at least one week ahead. You are expected to be available only during your assigned shifts—no availability is required outside those shifts and there is no unpaid standby. For reference, the 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET window corresponds to 10:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine time during US standard time and 9:00 PM–5:00 PM during US daylight saving time; your assigned shifts are within those windows and are not necessarily the full window. All onboarding and training are paid. After screening, there will be a short paid trial.



Your main job: follow up with our past clients and cold call US real estate agents to build referral relationships, while keeping every contact correctly tagged and moving through our GoHighLevel pipelines so nothing is missed.



What you’ll do



Make outbound calls to US real estate agents and loan officers using our scripts

Follow up with past and current clients by phone, text, and

Move contacts and opportunities through GoHighLevel pipelines and log every call with clear notes

Tag every contact correctly and keep the CRM clean

Book inspections and offer add-on services (radon, sewer scope, mold, termite, water testing)

Run agent outreach campaigns, follow up on tasks, and send review requests

Follow our SOPs and call scripts



Must have



1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, opportunities, tags, smart lists, Conversations, calendars, workflows

1+ year of outbound calling to US customers (BPO, sales, or appointment setting)

Clear, easy-to-understand, friendly phone English; careful listening and accurate intake are essential. A native accent is not required.

Reply to messages within 30–60 minutes during your assigned shift

Reliable internet plus a backup connection and backup power

Quiet workspace and a noise-canceling headset



Nice to have



US real estate, mortgage, or insurance experience

Spectora or other scheduling software



Why work with us



Long-term role with room to grow into full time

Bonus for agent relationships you build that turn into booked inspections

Small, supportive team with clear SOPs, scripts, and training



## How to Apply – Please Follow ALL Instructions



**Applications that do not follow every step will not be reviewed.**



**Subject Line:** GHL Pipeline Pro – [Your Name]



**1. Voice Recording (60–90 Seconds)**



Submit a consistent 60–90 second voice recording using Vocaroo or a similar platform. In your own words, briefly introduce yourself, then read the mock intake script below in a friendly, clear manner. After that, answer the unscripted prompt below as if you were speaking with the caller. We value easy-to-understand phone English, careful listening, and accurate intake; a native accent is not required.



**Mock intake script:** “Thank you for calling Up Close Inspections. This is [your name]. How can I help you today? I’d be happy to help with your inspection. May I have your name, the property address and your best callback number? Do you have an inspection deadline? I’ll check pricing and availability before confirming your appointment.”



**Unscripted prompt:** A client asks, “How much will it cost, and can you inspect tomorrow?” Assume you have not checked the price or availability. Explain that you will check before confirming; do not guess a price or promise an appointment.



**2. GoHighLevel Experience – Show Us Your Skills**



We don't just want to hear that you know GoHighLevel. **We want to see your actual experience.**



Submit a short screen-recorded video (Loom or similar) or a portfolio demonstrating your ability to work with:



- **Contact Tagging:** Organizing, segmenting, and managing contacts.

- **Pipelines:** Creating pipelines, managing opportunities, and moving leads through stages.

- **Workflows & Automations:** Building automated SMS,
, and follow-up sequences.

- **Lead Management:** Tracking conversations, scheduling follow-ups, and converting leads into customers.



You may use a demo account or previous work examples, provided no confidential client information is shown.



**3. Describe Your GHL Experience**



In 3–5 sentences, tell us about a GoHighLevel pipeline you've personally managed. Explain how you organized contacts, applied tags, built workflows, and followed up with leads.



**4. Outbound Calling Experience**



Tell us about your previous outbound calling experience, including:



- Company name and length of employment.

- Approximate number of outbound calls made daily.

- Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers or real estate professionals.



**5. Final Instruction**



End your application with the exact word **Cleveland**.



---



### What Happens Next?



Shortlisted applicants will complete the screening described above, including a short live mock call. After screening, selected candidates will be invited to a short paid trial. All onboarding, training, and trial work are paid.



We're looking for someone who combines **strong GoHighLevel technical skills, clear and friendly English communication, and a professional phone presence.**



At Up Close Inspections, we value clear communication, personal relationships, and outstanding customer service. We want someone who can represent our company confidently while helping us build lasting relationships with real estate agents and clients.

description:
# U.S. Tax Engagement Manager / Tax Operations Manager



**Location:** Philippines — Remote  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Project-Based  

**Compensation:** $5-10 USD/hour, depending on qualifications  

**Initial Workload:** Approximately 5–15 hours/week  

**Start:** Immediate



## About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur seeking an experienced Tax Engagement Manager or Tax Operations Manager to coordinate multiple accounting, tax-planning, and financial advisory projects.



I have several business and personal tax matters that require organized financial information, qualified professional input, and disciplined implementation.



I already have general administrative and operational assistants.



**I am not looking for another general virtual assistant or project manager.**



I need someone who understands U.S. tax workflows, accounting engagements, professional responsibilities, and the coordination required to bring complex financial projects to completion.



Ideally, you have worked within a U.S. CPA firm, tax advisory firm, or professional accounting practice.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Tax Engagement Management



- Organize tax and accounting projects.

- Identify required financial records and documentation.

- Coordinate work between bookkeepers, accountants, tax advisers, and attorneys.

- Establish timelines and deliverables.

- Track tax-related deadlines.

- Identify missing information and unresolved questions.

- Monitor project progress and quality.

- Ensure completed work is documented and reviewed.



### Specialist Sourcing & Coordination



- Identify the qualifications required for particular tax projects.

- Help source and evaluate appropriate specialists.

- Compare professional proposals and engagement scopes.

- Coordinate consultations and technical reviews.

- Track recommendations and implementation requirements.

- Identify overlapping responsibilities or gaps between advisers.

- Escalate important decisions to the business owner.



### Tax Research & Technical Understanding



Maintain sufficient knowledge of U.S. tax matters to intelligently coordinate work involving:



- Individual and small-business taxation.

- Schedule C and business deductions.

- Estimated tax payments.

- Retirement contributions.

- LLC, S-Corp, and C-Corp structures.

- Tax-planning engagements.

- California tax issues.

- Specialized tax and legal advisory projects.



You are not expected to personally provide advanced tax or legal opinions outside your qualifications.



However, you must understand the subject matter well enough to recognize missing expertise, incomplete work, and important dependencies.



### Project Ownership & Reporting



- Maintain a centralized project register.

- Assign and track action items.

- Coordinate administrative support.

- Produce concise weekly status reports.

- Identify stalled work and resolve operational obstacles.

- Present decisions requiring owner approval.

- Ensure approved recommendations are implemented correctly.



**Success means completed, properly reviewed work—not simply meetings, spreadsheets, or task updates.**



## Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of experience in a U.S. CPA firm, tax advisory firm, or U.S. tax operations environment.

- Familiarity with U.S. tax preparation and compliance workflows.

- Experience managing tax engagements, client deliverables, or accounting projects.

- Ability to coordinate multiple professionals.

- Strong documentation and organizational skills.

- Ability to identify missing information and project dependencies.

- Clear written English communication.

- Independent problem-solving and follow-through.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience as a Tax Engagement Manager, Tax Operations Manager, Senior Tax Associate, or Tax Practice Manager.

- Accounting or taxation background.

- Familiarity with Form 1040, Schedule C, 1120-S, and 1065 workflows.

- Experience coordinating tax-planning engagements.

- Familiarity with California tax matters.

- Experience evaluating professional proposals.

- Experience supervising remote accounting teams.

- Familiarity with tax practice-management software.

- Experience using AI-assisted research and workflow tools responsibly.



## Ideal Candidate



I am looking for someone who combines tax-domain understanding with strong project ownership.



You should be able to recognize when a tax project is missing important information, when a specialist is needed, and when a recommendation has not been properly implemented.



You should not require constant instructions or rely on the business owner to coordinate every professional.



**Your responsibility is to make the tax project move forward intelligently and reliably.**



## Initial Project



The initial engagement will involve coordinating a set of current-year tax and financial projects, including:



- Financial reconstruction and tax-readiness work.

- Tax projections and planning.

- Retirement contribution analysis.

- Business entity comparisons.

- Coordination with specialized tax and legal advisers.

- Documentation of implementation requirements and deadlines.



Expected deliverables include a prioritized project plan, professional responsibility matrix, decision register, deadline tracker, and concise executive briefings.



## Application Instructions — Read Carefully



Begin your application with the exact heading:



**Tax Engagement — Application**



Then provide:



1. Your résumé and experience working with U.S. tax or accounting firms.

2. Examples of tax engagements you personally coordinated.

3. Your understanding of U.S. tax preparation and planning workflows.

4. One example of a complex project you independently managed.

5. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer in approximately 150–200 words:



*A U.S. entrepreneur needs to reconstruct financial records, determine current-year tax obligations, evaluate retirement contributions, and investigate a future business ownership structure.*



**How would you organize the project, which specialists would you involve, what tasks could proceed in parallel, and which decisions would require professional review?**



We are evaluating your understanding of tax workflows, project dependencies, and independent judgment.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You may include a short 2–3 minute video describing your experience coordinating U.S. tax engagements and managing professional teams.



A simple recording is sufficient. Video is optional; equivalent written responses are welcome.



## Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid project-management assessment involving fictional tax and accounting scenarios.



We evaluate tax-workflow understanding, professional coordination, prioritization, documentation, and independent execution.



Please do not submit confidential client records.



**We are seeking someone who can intelligently manage complex tax engagements while minimizing the business owner's day-to-day involvement.**

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
We are a fast growing DTC skincare brand selling in 8 countries, producing direct with manufacturers in China and fulfilling through a 3PL and Amazon FBA. We are looking for a Supply Chain Manager to own everything from the factory to the warehouse shelf.



Full time. Owns production, inbound logistics, stock planning and Amazon inbound. Reports to the COO.



What You Own

-The suppliers. You are the single point of contact with our manufacturers in China. Pricing, production orders, cargo ready dates, and pushing for a partial shipment when we need stock sooner. You come back with a date, not with a promise to check.

-The stock. You know our stock level per SKU per market without being asked, and you reorder before anything runs out. If a SKU will go out of stock inside its own lead time, we hear it from you first. You also keep the 3PL inventory records right, per SKU code, and you flag it when their numbers and ours do not agree.

-Quality control. You agree the inspection date with the supplier, coordinate with our QC firm, and get the inspection booked in time to cover a meaningful part of the order rather than the last carton.

-Barcodes and labelling. The right barcode on the right product, checked on the line before production runs. A wrong barcode caught after 50,000 units are sealed is a failure of this role.

-Compliance and documentation. Lab testing for each market, certification, ingredient and claim documents, UPC registration, and checking packaging artwork before it goes to print.

-Inbound logistics. Freight quotes and bookings, sea and air, carton and pallet planning, customs and duty, and delivery into our 3PL.

-Amazon inbound. FBA shipment plans with our 3PL, relabelling instructions, cartonization, and getting goods dispatched into the Amazon warehouse.

-New product production. From sample through to first shipment.

-Supplier invoices. You prepare and submit them with the matching order so finance can verify and pay. You do not pay them yourself.

-Reporting. Stock cover per SKU, landed cost per SKU to finance, every open production order with its date, and anything at risk, once a week without being asked.



What You Do Not Own

This is here so there is no confusion about it later.

• Individual customer orders. Ready for pickup lists, failed deliveries, returns to sender, reshipments, refunds and fraud risk orders sit with the backend order team.

• Customer service and disputes.

• Paying invoices. You prepare, finance pays.

• The Amazon account itself. Listings, pricing, advertising and account health sit elsewhere. You own what physically goes into the warehouse.

How the Role Is Judged

• Nothing sits still without us knowing it is sitting. If you are waiting on a decision, a sample or a supplier, you say so the same day.

• No stockout that was visible in advance. Lead times are known, so running out is a planning failure, not bad luck.

• You raise the problem before it reaches us from the 3PL or from a customer.

• You do not need to be chased for an update.

What We’re Looking For

• You have run production directly with manufacturers in China, not through an agent or a trading company.

• You have placed and tracked purchase orders against lead times for a physical product business, with stock cover as the number you were judged on.

• You have shipped into Amazon FBA yourself: barcodes, labelling, cartonization, inbound placement.

• Cosmetics or another regulated category, so certification, claims and ingredient documents are not new to you.

• Freight experience: quotes, bookings, customs and duty, sea and air.

• You overlap with both China and Europe in your working day.

• Full time. This role failed before as a part time arrangement and we are not repeating that.

• You work ahead of the problem rather than reacting to it.



What to Include in Your Application

• The products you ran production for, the supplier country, and the volume per month or per year.

• One FBA shipment you planned, with the units and the carton count.

• A stockout you caused or inherited, and what you changed afterwards.

• One time you pushed a supplier into a date they said was impossible, and how.

• Your time zone and your working hours.

title: PERFORMANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER — STATIC AD
description:

This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

The role

We are looking for an experienced, senior Amazon specialist to take full, solo ownership of all our Amazon accounts across every country we sell in. You will be the one person responsible for our Amazon presence. There is no team below you and no one checking your work line by line – we need someone who treats these accounts as their own and makes sure everything is right before we ever have to ask.



What you will own

- Listings, perfected in every marketplace: titles, bullets, descriptions, backend keywords, images, variations, browse nodes and attributes – complete, accurate, optimised and localised for each country and language. No errors, no missing information, no suppressed or incomplete listings.

- Escalation: when something needs management's decision, you bring it to us with the problem clearly explained and your recommended solution – not just the problem.

This is an opportunity for an experienced estimator who understands both hardscape and softscape construction and has the technical ability to turn landscape drawings into accurate, competitive and commercially sound project estimates. 



You'll play an important role in supporting our national project pipeline, working closely with our Commercial and Operations teams to help secure and deliver quality landscaping projects throughout New Zealand. 



The Opportunity 



The primary focus of this role is to prepare accurate and commercially competitive estimates for a diverse range of commercial and residential landscaping projects. 



You will be responsible for reviewing construction drawings and tender documentation, completing detailed quantity take-offs, preparing schedules of quantities (SOQs), bills of quantities (BOQs), cost build-ups and draft tender estimates. 



Using our established in-house pricing models and estimating tools, you will help ensure projects are priced accurately, efficiently and with a strong understanding of the practical requirements of landscape construction. 



Your Scope of Work 



Hard Landscaping 



Segmental paving including setts, pavers and natural stone. 



Concrete  



Site preparation and associated external works. 



Retaining walls, steps, ramps and associated structures. 



Drainage and stormwater interfaces. 



Landscape structures, street furniture and external works. 



Soft Landscaping 



Soil preparation, garden beds and planting areas. 



Trees, shrubs, ground covers and specimen planting. 



Turfing, lawn installation and hydroseeding. 



Mulching, topsoil and soil conditioning. 



Irrigation systems and associated infrastructure. 



Plant supply, delivery and installation. 



Garden establishment and landscape finishing works. 



Key Responsibilities 



Review construction drawings, specifications and tender documentation to identify and measure project requirements using Groundplan takeoff software 



Complete accurate quantity take-offs and prepare detailed schedules of quantities (SOQs)  



Develop detailed material, labour and plant cost estimates using excel pricing templates 



Populate, maintain and improve company pricing models and estimating tools. 



Obtain, assess and compare supplier and subcontractor pricing. 



Review tender addenda and drawing amendments, ensuring all changes are incorporated into estimates. 



Maintain accurate estimating records and contribute to the development of standardised cost libraries. 



Work collaboratively with Commercial and Operations teams to ensure estimates are practical, accurate and commercially viable. 



Skills & Experience 



We are looking for someone who has a strong background in a commercial landscaping environment. 



Essential Requirements 



High level written and spoken English 



A recognised Quantity Surveying qualification. 



Minimum of 2 years' proven estimating experience within a large commercial landscaping business. 



Demonstrated experience preparing estimates from landscape construction drawings. 



Strong ability to interpret drawings, specifications and tender documentation. 



Proven experience completing detailed quantity take-offs  



Sound understanding of both hardscape and softscape construction methods, materials and installation requirements. 



Knowledge of New Zealand and Australian construction methods and practices. 



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with pricing models. 



Experience using Groundplan quantity take-off software. 



Strong understanding of construction costs, labour requirements, productivity, plant and subcontractor pricing. 



Proficiency across Microsoft platforms. 



Please note: Applicants must be able to provide examples of previous estimating work to demonstrate their technical capability and experience. 



The Person We're Looking For 



Beyond technical estimating ability, we're looking for someone who takes pride in producing accurate work and understands the commercial realities of delivering construction projects. 



You'll demonstrate: 



Strong commercial awareness and exceptional attention to detail. 



Excellent analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills. 



The ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously. 



A proactive and organised approach to your workload. 



Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 



A willingness to continually develop knowledge across both hardscape and softscape disciplines. 



The ability to work independently while remaining connected and collaborative with a wider team. 



A practical understanding of how outdoor construction projects are built, not just how they are priced. 



Ready to Join Us? 



Please submit your CV and a short cover letter along with examples of previous estimating work demonstrating your experience in commercial landscaping.

title: YouTube Video Editor – History, Zoology & Paleontology
description:
ABOUT US



I run a paleontology channel and a zoology channel. I am currently preparing to launch a new history channel and am in need of an editor.



Our videos are narrated, faceless educational videos. I write the scripts and record the voiceovers. We need an editor who can turn that narration into a visual story that keeps viewers watching.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Build the full visual track for narrated videos of 15–20+ minutes from the voiceover.

- Research and source visuals that match the script line by line: historical paintings, accurate drawings, photographs, archival footage, B-roll, maps, fossil imagery, scientific illustrations, and more.

- Add motion to keep the videos feeling alive and fluid: simple animations, maps, timelines, labels, and text callouts where they help understanding.

- Deliver a finished 1080p video ready to upload, with up to 3 rounds of revisions.

- Keep a simple source log of where each visual came from.



WORK VOLUME



- About 2–4 videos per month across the channels to start, with room to grow.

- Ongoing contractor relationship.

- Fully remote; worldwide applicants welcome.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU



- Have experience editing faceless, narrated YouTube videos.

- Love finding the right image, not just any image. You'd rather hunt for an 1850s engraving than use generic stock footage.

- Understand pacing and retention: a new visual every few seconds, without long, drawn-out still images.

- Are curious about history, science, or natural history (a big plus).

- Can communicate in English, meet deadlines, and let us know early when you're unavailable.



To let us know you've read this section, put the word "trilobite" at the top of your application, immediately after your name.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with map animations, simple motion graphics, or photo animation.

- Familiarity with sources like Wikimedia Commons, ArtStation, DeviantArt, Pinterest, and documentaries.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Finished scripts and recorded narration for every video.

- Reference videos and a style guide.

- Fast, specific feedback and a steady flow of work for the right person.

- Guidance and support whenever you're stuck. We'll have someone available to offer advice.



HOW TO APPLY

title: General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer
description:
General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer  



Remote | Philippines-Based | Monday to Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm AEST



**To Apply** 



The General Insurance Claims & Administration Officer will provide claims and administrative support to a well-established general insurance broking firm in the Australian market. The role is primarily claims-focused: working under the direction of the Claims Consultant, you will help progress general insurance claims accurately and promptly through claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, and record maintenance. 



Alongside claims, the role provides policy-servicing and general administrative support to the broking team to keep the brokerage running smoothly day to day. 





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



** Claims Support **  



Claims Lodgements 

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge new general insurance claims accurately and promptly through insurer portals and systems, in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions 

- Accurately record client issues, claim details, and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM 



Insurer and Claims Follow-Up 

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims, including making follow-up calls and remaining on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps 

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue 

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes 

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant 



Documentation and Information Requests 

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, repair or replacement information, and any other documentation required by the insurer 

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant, and report progress on outstanding documentation 

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system 



Claims Administration 

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records 

- Diary and action follow-ups to keep claims progressing 

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultant 

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly 

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant 





** Policy Servicing and Administrative Support **

 

- Manage and service an existing portfolio of clients across Builders Warranty and Construction policies, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Prepare quotes, policy documentation, renewals, endorsements, amendments, and cancellations 

- Assist brokers with assessing client needs and sourcing, negotiating, and placing suitable insurance policies with insurers 

- Maintain and update client databases, policy records, and CRM documentation accurately and promptly 

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the broking team, including data entry, filing, and document management 

- Handle and liaise with insurers on behalf of clients on policy and servicing matters 

- Manage client enquiries professionally and efficiently through the firm’s approved communication channels 

- Build and maintain professional working relationships with clients and insurers, within the role’s defined authority 

- Identify and refer appropriate upsell or cross-sell opportunities to the broking team 

- Follow industry regulations, internal procedures, and documentation standards 

- Support the team with ad-hoc administrative tasks and projects as required 





SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 



You Must Have 

- 3 - 4 years of administrative or office support experience in general insurance, working for an Australian-based insurance broker 

- Hands-on experience in general insurance claims lodgement and claims management (not life, health, or superannuation) 

- Familiarity with general insurance terminology and insurer portals. 

- Well organised and highly motivated, with strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple clients, and meet deadlines 

- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment 

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach 

- Confident negotiation and problem-solving abilities 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint 

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team 



Nice to have

- Experience using Insight or Office Tech broking systems 

- Experience managing or servicing Builders Warranty and Construction policy portfolios, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Understanding of insurance products, policy wordings, and risk assessment 

- Proficiency with insurance broking systems 

- Tier 1 RG146 qualification 





**To Apply**

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes
