title: Performance Creative Designer — Static Ads
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.





REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: U.S. Accounting Manager / Financial Controller
description:
# U.S. Accounting Manager / Financial Controller



**Location:** Philippines — Remote  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Project-Based, with Long-Term Potential  

**Compensation:** $5-$10 USD/hour, depending on experience  

**Initial Workload:** Approximately 10–20 hours/week



## About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur developing Rank & Rent Factory (RNRF), a scalable portfolio of local-service lead-generation websites.



I am seeking an experienced accounting manager or financial controller who can help establish reliable financial systems, oversee bookkeeping, analyze business performance, and support informed financial decisions.



My long-term goal is to build a scalable, systems-driven business with clear financial reporting and disciplined capital allocation.



**This is not a basic bookkeeping or data-entry position.**



I am looking for someone who understands the broader financial picture, can manage accounting workflows, identify problems, and help develop financial systems that scale.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Financial Accounting & Oversight



- Oversee bookkeeping accuracy and account reconciliations.

- Review financial statements and accounting records.

- Establish and maintain appropriate accounting controls.

- Organize business income, expenses, assets, and liabilities.

- Coordinate month-end and year-end accounting.

- Identify discrepancies and financial reporting issues.

- Support tax accountants with accurate financial information.



### Financial Reporting & Analysis



- Prepare and review profit-and-loss statements.

- Develop cash-flow reports and forecasts.

- Track operating expenses and financial commitments.

- Analyze profitability by business activity.

- Monitor budgets and financial performance.

- Identify cost inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

- Produce concise financial reports for the owner.



### RNRF Portfolio Financial Management



As the business develops, responsibilities may include:



- Tracking financial performance by website and market.

- Monitoring hosting, software, content, and production costs.

- Measuring cost per completed website.

- Tracking revenue generated by lead-generation assets.

- Evaluating portfolio profitability.

- Supporting reinvestment and capital allocation decisions.

- Building scalable financial dashboards and reporting systems.



### Financial Systems & Process Improvement



- Establish practical accounting workflows.

- Develop documentation and internal controls.

- Coordinate bookkeeping support.

- Improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.

- Evaluate appropriate financial software.

- Implement AI-assisted workflows where useful and properly reviewed.

- Identify and resolve recurring financial process problems.



### Professional Coordination



- Coordinate with tax preparers and external accountants.

- Prepare accurate records for professional review.

- Identify financial and accounting issues requiring specialist input.

- Support future entity accounting and financial administration.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 5 years of professional accounting experience.

- Experience managing or reviewing accounting work.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. accounting practices and financial reporting.

- Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Experience preparing and interpreting financial statements.

- Cash-flow analysis and budgeting experience.

- Strong reconciliation and accounting-control skills.

- Ability to work independently and improve financial processes.

- Clear written English communication.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Accounting degree or CPA qualification.

- Experience as an Accounting Manager, Senior Accountant, or Controller.

- Experience with U.S. small businesses.

- Experience managing bookkeepers or accounting teams.

- Financial modeling and forecasting experience.

- Experience with multi-entity accounting.

- Experience with digital businesses or recurring revenue.

- Familiarity with U.S. tax preparation workflows.

- Experience developing financial dashboards and automation.



## Ideal Candidate



I value someone who thinks beyond bookkeeping.



You should understand what financial statements reveal about a business, identify potential problems, and recommend improvements.



You should be comfortable establishing systems from an early stage and adapting them as the business grows.



**The objective is not simply accurate accounting. It is reliable financial intelligence that supports better business decisions.**



## Initial Project



The initial engagement may involve:



- Assessing existing accounting records and systems.

- Reviewing or supervising bookkeeping cleanup.

- Establishing financial reporting standards.

- Developing preliminary cash-flow reports.

- Identifying missing financial controls.

- Creating a scalable accounting and reporting roadmap.



The role may expand as RNRF grows.



## Application Instructions — Read Carefully



Begin your application with the exact heading:



**Financial Controller — Application**



Then provide:



1. Your résumé and accounting management experience.

2. Examples of financial reporting systems you have managed or developed.

3. Your QuickBooks and financial software experience.

4. One example of a financial problem you identified and helped resolve.

5. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer in approximately 150 words:



*A digital business owns 30 lead-generation websites. Some produce revenue, others are still being developed, and each has different hosting, content, production, and maintenance costs.*



**What financial metrics and reporting systems would you establish to evaluate profitability, cash flow, and future investment decisions?**



We are evaluating your ability to think beyond bookkeeping and support business management.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You may include a 2–3 minute video describing your accounting leadership experience and one financial reporting or process-improvement project.



Video is optional; equivalent written responses are welcome.



## Selection Process



Shortlisted applicants may complete a paid practical assessment involving financial statements, cash-flow analysis, and accounting controls.



We are looking for a financially sophisticated professional who can help build reliable systems and support the long-term growth of RNRF.

title: U.S. Tax Planning & Advisory Specialist
description:
# U.S. Tax Planning & Advisory Specialist



**Location:** Philippines — Remote  

**Employment:** Part-Time / Project-Based  

**Compensation:** $5-10 USD/hour, based on demonstrated expertise  

**Initial Workload:** Approximately 5–15 hours/week  

**Start:** Immediate



## About the Opportunity



I am a U.S.-based entrepreneur seeking an experienced U.S. tax advisory professional to help evaluate tax-planning strategies, analyze financial alternatives, and coordinate specialized advisers.



My current business activities are primarily operated as a sole proprietor. I am also developing Rank & Rent Factory (RNRF), a scalable portfolio of digital lead-generation assets.



I am interested in legitimate tax efficiency, capital preservation, business ownership structures, retirement planning, and eventually establishing residence outside California and the United States.



**This is a tax-planning and advisory research position—not routine bookkeeping, data entry, or basic tax preparation.**



I already have operational support and may engage separate bookkeepers and tax preparers.



I am looking for someone who understands U.S. tax concepts well enough to identify meaningful opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, challenge questionable claims, and recognize when specialized professional review is necessary.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Tax Strategy Research & Evaluation



Investigate and compare strategies involving:



- Sole proprietorships, LLCs, S-Corps, and C-Corps.

- Business deductions and tax credits.

- Retirement contributions, Solo 401(k), traditional and Roth accounts.

- ROBS (Rollovers as Business Startups).

- Business ownership and holding structures.

- Depreciation and tax-advantaged investments.

- California tax residency and income sourcing.

- International relocation and cross-border taxation.

- Trusts, estate planning, and asset protection.



You are not expected to be an expert in every specialty. You must identify when qualified tax, legal, retirement-plan, or international advisers are required.



### Financial & Tax Analysis



- Prepare tax-planning comparisons and financial scenarios.

- Analyze current versus future tax consequences.

- Evaluate cash-flow and liquidity implications.

- Research eligibility requirements and implementation deadlines.

- Identify risks, restrictions, and unresolved questions.

- Distinguish legitimate opportunities from aggressive or unsupported claims.

- Prepare concise, evidence-based written recommendations.



### Professional Coordination



- Identify the types of specialists required for particular strategies.

- Help assess professional qualifications and proposals.

- Prepare technical questions for adviser consultations.

- Coordinate research and implementation with accountants and attorneys.

- Maintain a prioritized tax-strategy register.

- Track unresolved issues and professionally reviewed recommendations.



### Communication & Project Ownership



- Independently investigate assigned financial questions.

- Clearly explain alternatives and tradeoffs.

- Identify missing information.

- Escalate decisions requiring owner approval.

- Take responsibility for completing assigned research and coordination projects.



## Required Qualifications



- At least 4 years of substantial U.S. tax experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability.

- Direct exposure to tax planning, advisory engagements, or tax research.

- Strong understanding of U.S. individual and business taxation.

- Familiarity with entity taxation and retirement-related tax issues.

- Experience preparing tax projections or comparing planning scenarios.

- Ability to research authoritative IRS and state tax sources.

- Strong analytical and written communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and recognize professional limitations.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Active IRS Enrolled Agent or U.S. CPA credential.

- Philippine CPA with substantial U.S. tax advisory experience.

- Experience in a U.S. CPA or tax advisory firm.

- Experience with California tax matters.

- Exposure to international tax planning.

- Experience coordinating tax attorneys or other specialists.

- Experience evaluating retirement and business ownership strategies.



Please identify the jurisdiction and current status of any professional credentials.



## Initial Project



Evaluate a prioritized set of current-year tax-planning questions and future business-structure alternatives.



Deliverables may include:



- Tax strategy comparison matrix.

- Preliminary financial and tax scenarios.

- Source-backed research findings.

- Identification of specialist requirements.

- Implementation dependencies and deadlines.

- Concise recommendations for owner review.



This role may develop into an ongoing tax advisory coordination relationship.



## Application Instructions — Read Carefully



Begin your application with this exact heading:



**Tax Strategy — Application**



Then provide:



1. Your résumé and relevant U.S. tax advisory experience.

2. One example of a tax-planning strategy you personally analyzed.

3. Your experience with business entities, retirement accounts, or tax credits.

4. Your credentials, hourly rate, and weekly availability.

5. One example of a complex tax issue where you recognized the need for specialist advice.



### Required Technical Question



Please answer in approximately 150–200 words:



*A U.S. sole proprietor has approximately $140,000 in annual business income, $100,000 in liquid cash, no retirement savings, and expects relatively low income next year while building a new business.*



**What three tax-planning strategies would you prioritize investigating, what information is missing, and what risks or limitations would you flag?**



We value sound reasoning and professional judgment over promises of tax savings.



### Optional Video Introduction — Preferred



You may submit a 2–3 minute video explaining your U.S. tax advisory background and one meaningful planning engagement.



A simple recording is sufficient. Video is optional; equivalent written responses are welcome.



## Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates may complete a paid technical assessment using fictional financial information.



We evaluate tax reasoning, research accuracy, financial judgment, professional boundaries, and independent initiative.



Do not submit confidential client information.



**We are looking for a thoughtful tax professional who can help investigate, evaluate, and coordinate legitimate financial strategies—not someone who simply repeats tax-saving claims.**

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "QUALITY CHECK" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Graphic Designer | Brand Identity & Presentations
description:
**About Us**



We're a small, creative team based in Los Angeles, working across entertainment, production, wellness, beauty, and emerging brands.



We're looking for a talented, versatile graphic designer to collaborate with us on a variety of projects, with a strong emphasis on **designing pitch decks, presentations, and creative treatments**, alongside brand identities, product concepts, packaging, and marketing materials.



Presentation design will be a significant and consistent part of this role, so we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys turning ideas, information, and visual references into beautifully designed, compelling decks.



**What You'll Do**



- **Design and refine pitch decks, presentations, creative treatments, capabilities decks, and proposals.** This will be one of your primary responsibilities.

- Build presentations from scratch and elevate existing decks through thoughtful typography, layout, composition, imagery, and visual storytelling.

- Develop and evolve brand identities, including typography, color palettes, visual systems, and brand guidelines.

- Create thoughtful layouts, moodboards, and visual concepts that communicate ideas clearly and beautifully.

- Contribute to packaging concepts, product presentations, and marketing materials.

- Work across multiple brands, each with its own distinct identity, audience, and creative direction.

- Transform rough ideas, references, and existing materials into polished, professional designs.

- Collaborate closely with our team, incorporating feedback while contributing your own creative perspective.



**What We're Looking For**



Above all, we're looking for someone with a great eye for design.



Someone who understands that great design isn't about applying the same aesthetic to every project. It's about finding the right visual language for the idea, brand, or story.



Our ideal candidate has:



- A strong portfolio demonstrating versatility, originality, and thoughtful design.

- **Proven experience creating beautifully designed presentations and pitch decks**, with an excellent understanding of pacing, visual storytelling, and slide composition.

- Excellent understanding of typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy, and layout.

- Experience with branding and identity development, not just creating individual graphics.

- The ability to create custom, intentional designs rather than relying on generic templates.

- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Experience with Google Slides, PowerPoint, and/or Canva, with the ability to create fully editable presentations.

- Strong attention to detail and a willingness to refine work until it feels right.

- Good communication skills, creative curiosity, and the ability to work independently.



Experience with product packaging, editorial design, luxury or lifestyle brands, and entertainment or advertising is a plus.



**The Ideal Fit**



We're looking for a designer who can be both creative and practical.



Some projects will begin with a well-defined direction. Others might start with a few images, a rough concept, or an idea that needs to be explored visually.



You'll need to be comfortable with both.



We appreciate sophisticated, considered design, but don't believe every project should look or feel the same. Some brands call for restraint and simplicity. Others need personality, warmth, energy, or something unexpected.



What matters is the ability to understand the creative intention and develop a visual approach that feels distinctive, cohesive, and appropriate.



We're not looking for someone who simply makes things look nice. We're looking for someone who understands how design gives an idea its identity.



**Position Details**



- Part-time, remote

- Approximately 15–20 hours per week to start

- Flexible schedule, with some availability during Los Angeles business hours

- Ongoing collaboration across several brands and creative projects

- Potential for additional hours and responsibilities as we grow



**To Apply**



Please share your portfolio, **including examples of pitch decks or presentations you've personally designed**, as well as branding and other creative work that demonstrates your range.



We're particularly interested in seeing projects where you've helped establish or interpret a brand's visual identity.



Please also include your preferred design software, hourly rate, and general availability.

title: Senior Executive Assistant & Project Operations Lead – Luxury Residential Design-Build (Remote)
description:
About us

Exhale Designs is a Florida-based residential design and construction firm working on high-end renovations, additions, pools, and full home transformations, with project values reaching into seven figures. Our clients are busy high-income homeowners and real estate investors who hire us so they don’t have to manage the details. We’re growing, and we need a senior right hand who can run the back office of every project so our project manager can focus on the field.



This role is for you if



You think two steps ahead and see the bottleneck before it happens

You own outcomes, not just tasks

You write clearly and professionally enough to represent us to clients, vendors, and town officials

You build systems and processes, not just follow them



What you’ll own



Preconstruction



Keep the latest drawing revisions and contract scope organized and on file

Prepare and track permit applications, Notices of Commencement, and HOA approvals through to approval

Track client selections and get written sign-off before anything is ordered

Flag long-lead items and place or track those orders first

Arrange utility locate requests, dumpsters, and portable toilets before work starts



Subcontractor administration



Prepare sub agreements with a written scope for each trade

Track insurance certificate (COI) expiration dates so coverage never lapses

Collect partial lien releases with every progress payment

Check sub invoices against contract amounts and work completed before payment



Inspections and scheduling



Schedule municipal inspections and track results so nothing gets covered up early

Coordinate sub and vendor schedules with the project manager



Change orders and budget



Write and price change orders, note schedule impact, and get client signatures before work proceeds

Track actual cost against budget weekly in JobTread

Prepare client draws and invoices tied to project milestones



Procurement and deliveries



Create and manage purchase orders for materials, furniture, and finishes

Reconcile deliveries against POs using field reports, and log back orders and returns



Client communication



Draft the weekly client update covering progress, next week’s plan, and decisions needed

Maintain a decision log so every verbal approval is documented



Documentation



Compile daily logs from field notes, including crew on site, work completed, and weather delays

Keep project photos and files organized in JobTread



Closeout



Prepare punch lists and track items to completion

Coordinate final inspections and certificate of occupancy or permit close-out

Assemble the client closeout package with warranties, manuals, and the paint and finish schedule

Collect final photos and client sign-off



Executive support



Manage the owner’s and project manager’s inbox and calendar

Prepare meeting agendas and recaps

Build and improve our templates, checklists, and SOPs as we scale



Requirements



5+ years of executive assistant, project coordinator, or construction administration experience

Direct experience with residential construction paperwork: permits, lien releases, COIs, change orders, and draws

Hands-on experience with JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore, or similar

Strong command of Microsoft 365, Dropbox, and Excel budget tracking

Native-level written and spoken English

Available during US Eastern business hours

References from past executives or clients



Bonus points



Florida permitting experience (Notices of Commencement, municipal portals)

Experience supporting a business owner directly

Background in interior design procurement or luxury home services



Compensation

Competitive pay for top talent: [$12–$20per hour]. Long-term role with room to grow as the company scales.



To apply



Record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and describing the most complex construction project you’ve supported.

In writing, explain how you would make sure no subcontractor gets paid without a current COI and a signed partial lien release.

Start your message with the word “Blueprint.”



Applications missing any of these won’t be reviewed. Finalists will complete a short paid trial task.

title: Heir Outreach Specialist
description:
We are hiring the person everyone tells things to.



JABO REI is a US real estate firm. We buy houses families inherited and never settled. The paperwork tells us what happened, never why a family left its largest asset untouched for ten years. Your job: be the first voice that family hears — and come back with the why.



Most callers stop at the first answer. Ours don't.



An heir says: "We just haven't gotten around to it." That's Level 1 — the reason given. Level 2 is the cause: what made it hard to get around to? "My brother won't return my calls." Level 3 is the root: why won't he? He cared for their mother in that house. He believes it's his.



Reaching Level 3 can't be scripted. It happens because the heir said one sentence that wasn't the whole story — and you noticed, and your next question walked through the door it opened. If you already listen this way, you know what we're describing. If you don't, no training fixes it. That's why we test for it before we hire.



The work



- First calls to heirs from fully researched files — family tree, debts, documents — during US hours (overnight PH).

- You talk less than a third of the time. No selling, no pitch, no commission — a separate team handles offers, by design.

- Every call ends with something real: a next step at a specific time, or a family that trusts you'll call back.

- Your notes retell the whole story, complications included.

- Calls are recorded and graded on depth and listening, never dial volume.

- Hours start at 4/day, growing as your deals close: 5 after your first, 6 after your second.



Don't apply if a script is your safety net, silence makes you fill it, commission is your fuel, or a painful story sends you reaching for comfortable phrases.



Background: outbound calling experience is required — you must already be at home on live calls with strangers. Real estate and sales experience are not: sales habits usually have to be unlearned here. Our best people come from escalations, retention, intake, care coordination — anywhere the real job was hearing people in hard moments.



Pay: $5/hr starting, flexible based on skill — the assessment d
 where you land. Remote.



How hiring works (same for everyone):



1. Answer the application question below.

2. A personal packet: résumé plus a free DISC assessment.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer / Tech Lead
description:
our Build AI | Full-Time | High-Performance Opportunity



Website: 



About Your Build AI



Your Build AI is an Australian technology company specialising in AI-powered software development, intelligent automation and business transformation.



We work with businesses, including large organisations and enterprise-level clients, to design, develop and implement sophisticated AI solutions that improve operations, eliminate inefficiencies and create genuine commercial advantages.



Our work goes beyond basic automation and chatbot development. We build complex, integrated technology solutions, including AI agents, custom software, intelligent workflows, API integrations, business management systems and bespoke AI-powered platforms.



We’re growing and looking for an exceptional developer to become a key part of the business and help lead the technical development and delivery of our projects.



The Opportunity



We’re looking for an absolute weapon in software development and AI engineering.



This isn’t an entry-level position, and we’re not looking for someone who has simply jumped on the AI bandwagon over the last couple of years.



We want someone who was passionate about software engineering long before the current AI boom. Someone with a strong foundation in traditional software development who has since evolved their skill set to understand and leverage the latest advancements in artificial intelligence.



You’ll be responsible for both building solutions yourself and overseeing the technical direction of projects.



You’ll work closely with business leadership, clients and other stakeholders to architect, develop and deliver sophisticated technology solutions.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of the technical function of a growing company, work on substantial projects and play a major role in shaping the future of the business.



What We’re Looking For



1. Strong Software Engineering Foundations



A substantial background in software development, PREdating the recent AI boom.

Deep understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms and software architecture.

Strong experience with backend and frontend development.

Ability to independently design, develop, debug and maintain complex applications.

Understanding of databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security and scalable system design.

Ability to write clean, efficient, maintainable and production-ready code.



2. Advanced AI & Automation Experience



Extensive practical experience developing and implementing AI-powered applications.

Experience working with LLMs, including OpenAI, Anthropic and other leading AI models.

Understanding of AI agents, agentic workflows, RAG systems, vector databases and retrieval pipelines.

Experience with AI orchestration frameworks and automation platforms.

Ability to integrate AI into existing business systems and software environments.

Understanding of model limitations, hallucinations, evaluation, reliability and production deployment.



3. Full-Stack Development & Integrations



Strong experience building full-stack applications.

Extensive experience working with APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations.

Experience with modern frameworks and programming languages.

Familiarity with cloud environments, deployment pipelines, CI/CD and infrastructure.

Ability to build custom platforms, dashboards, portals and complex business applications.

Experience connecting multiple software systems into cohesive, intelligent ecosystems.



4. Technical Leadership & Project Ownership



Ability to independently architect and lead complex development projects.

Confident making technical decisions and recommending the right solutions.

Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliverables.

Experience managing development timelines, priorities and project delivery.

Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Willingness to take complete ownership of projects from initial concept through to deployment and ongoing optimisation.



A Very Important Requirement: Genuine Development Expertise



We want to make something very clear.



We embrace AI and expect our developers to use the latest tools to improve productivity. However, we are not looking for someone who relies entirely on AI coding assistants to produce work they don’t fundamentally understand.



You must be able to write, understand, review, debug and optimise code independently.



You should understand exactly what your code is doing, why it works, how the underlying systems interact and how to resolve problems when things go wrong.



AI should make you a better developer, not substitute for your development knowledge.



We want someone who can build sophisticated systems from the ground up, not someone who can only prompt their way through a project.



Portfolio & Previous Work – Mandatory



This is a non-negotiable requirement.



Applicants must have their own professional website or portfolio showcasing their development experience, previous projects and technical capabilities.



We specifically want to see developers who have taken the initiative to build their own professional online presence.



Your portfolio should demonstrate:



Previous software development projects.

AI applications or automation systems you’ve built.

Examples of complex integrations or platforms you’ve developed.

Your technical capabilities and development experience.

Your specific role and contribution to the projects showcased.



We want to see real work, not just a list of technologies on a CV.



Applicants without a personal professional website or portfolio showcasing their work will not be considered.



Technologies & Experience



Experience with some or most of the following is highly desirable:



Python, JavaScript and TypeScript.

React, Next.js and Node.js.

FastAPI, Django or similar backend frameworks.

PostgreSQL, Supabase and other database technologies.

OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.

LangChain, LangGraph and similar AI frameworks.

RAG architecture and vector databases.

REST APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations.

AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent cloud infrastructure.

Docker, Git, CI/CD and deployment infrastructure.

AI agents, workflow orchestration and intelligent automation.



We value actual engineering capability over familiarity with a particular technology stack.



What We Offer



We’re looking for someone who wants more than just another development job.



The successful applicant will receive:



Full-time employment.

Competitive remuneration based on experience and capability.

Performance-based bonuses and additional incentives.

Additional perks and benefits.

Opportunity to work on significant projects for large businesses and enterprise clients.

Significant autonomy and ownership over technical delivery.

Direct involvement in technical strategy and business growth.

Opportunity to build and lead the technical function as the company scales.

A position where exceptional performance and contribution are genuinely rewarded.



For the right person, there is significant long-term opportunity.



Who Should Apply?



You should be someone who:



Has spent years developing software and understands the fundamentals inside out.

Has successfully built and deployed multiple real-world applications.

Is genuinely passionate about technology and engineering.

Has kept up with the latest advancements in AI and knows how to implement them properly.

Can work independently without needing constant supervision.

Is comfortable taking responsibility for complex technical projects.

Takes pride in the quality, performance and reliability of their work.

Wants to be part of something ambitious and help build a serious technology company.



We’re not looking for someone who simply wants to complete tickets and collect a salary. We want someone who takes ownership, thinks commercially and is motivated by building exceptional technology.





Please only apply if you have your own website & genuinely meet the experience and technical requirements outlined above.



Your Build AI

Mario Moosbauer · Growald Agency · Munich, Germany

Your first projects will be automations for our agency clients.



MEASURABLE OUTCOMES

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- you only write ChatGPT prompts and have never shipped code

- you need step-by-step instructions for every task

- you have certificates and courses but nothing you built yourself

- you already work several full-time jobs



POSITION DETAILS



Schedule: 20 hrs/week, flexible, you choose when you work

Location: 100% remote

Contract: Freelance

Start: As soon as possible

Growth: More hours as results come in



HOW TO APPLY



Send me a message here on OnlineJobs with your CV. In your message, describe ONE automation you built that is running today: what it replaced, which tools and code you used, and how much time or money it saves. A link to the code or a short demo video helps a lot.



Applications without a real example will not be considered.



Mario Moosbauer

Growald Agency ·

Start your application with a direct link to one complete, published YouTube property walkthrough you personally edited. A relocation or map-tour sample is welcome as a second link.

title: Long-Form YouTube Editor for On-Location Tours & Talking Heads
description:
HOW TO APPLY

Start with a direct link to one complete, published 15–30 minute YouTube video you personally edited. Pick a video where a host moves through a location and talks on camera. A home tour, travel vlog, neighborhood guide, or similar on-location video works. Include a timestamp from the middle and one sentence explaining what you edited. Then share your expected monthly rate and confirm your weekly availability and ability to handle the deliverables below. A reel or general portfolio can be included as a second link.



ABOUT THE CHANNEL

I’m a real estate agent building Living on the Alabama Gulf Coast, a YouTube channel for people relocating to Baldwin County, Alabama. I film host-led home and community tours, relocation videos, and talking heads. Experience with real estate is welcome. Your sample can come from another niche if it shows the same on-camera storytelling and pacing.



WEEKLY DELIVERABLES

• Two long-form YouTube edits, typically 15–30 minutes for tours and 10–20 minutes for talking heads

• Two thumbnails, one per video

• About two short clips repurposed from the finished videos



EDITING STYLE AND WORKFLOW

Keep my delivery conversational. Cut repeated takes and distracting pauses, maintain the flow as I move through a location, and use supplied close-ups and local B-roll to show what I’m talking about. Add clear text or map graphics where useful, balance dialogue and music, correct color, and work from organized footage in Google Drive. I’ll provide footage, style references, and feedback.



COMPENSATION

Remote, part-time, long-term. Budget is $800–$1,100 USD per month for about 20–25 hours per week, depending on experience and agreed scope. We’ll start with a short paid editing test using my footage.

title: Project Operations Manager
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and results-driven Project Operations Manager to oversee daily operations, project schedules, employee accountability, and client deliverables within a growing professional services business.



This is a hands-on management position responsible for ensuring that work gets completed on time, employees stay on task, deadlines are met, and client commitments are fulfilled.



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, follows up relentlessly, identifies problems before they become bigger issues, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.



The primary objective is simple: Manage daily execution so the business owner does not have to manage everyone's schedules, assignments, and deliverables.



Key Responsibilities



1. Daily Project & Workflow Management



Review daily and weekly project schedules.



Assign and monitor tasks across team members.



Ensure employees understand their priorities and deadlines.



Monitor project progress and identify potential delays.



Follow up on outstanding assignments to ensure timely completion.



Keep projects moving forward and prevent work from getting stalled.



2. Team Accountability & Performance



Conduct brief daily team check-ins.



Ensure team members are completing assigned responsibilities.



Follow up on missed deadlines and incomplete assignments.



Identify employees who are falling behind or struggling with workload.



Address accountability issues directly and professionally.



Escalate recurring performance concerns to ownership.



3. Client Deliverables & Service Quality



Monitor client deliverables and ensure deadlines are met.



Track outstanding client requests and follow-up items.



Ensure projects are progressing according to agreed timelines.



Identify potential client service issues before they escalate.



Coordinate communication between team members to ensure a consistent client experience.



4. Scheduling & Capacity Management



Maintain project schedules and team calendars.



Monitor employee workloads and capacity.



Identify scheduling conflicts and resource constraints.



Coordinate the distribution of work across the team.



Ensure upcoming deadlines are anticipated and properly assigned.



5. Reporting & Operational Oversight



Maintain dashboards showing project status and outstanding tasks.



Prepare weekly operational reports for ownership.



Track completion rates, overdue projects, and employee productivity.



Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend improvements.



Ensure project management systems are consistently updated.



Daily Operating Expectations



The Project Operations Manager will establish and maintain a consistent daily operating rhythm:



Morning: Review schedules, priorities, deadlines, and employee assignments.



Daily check-in: Confirm priorities and identify obstacles.



Midday: Monitor progress and follow up on outstanding work.



End of day: Review completed assignments and identify unfinished items.



Weekly: Provide ownership with a summary of team performance, project status, overdue deliverables, and operational concerns.



Required Qualifications



3+ years of project management, operations management, or team leadership experience.



Experience managing employees or remote teams.



Strong organizational and follow-up skills.



Experience managing multiple projects and competing deadlines.



Ability to hold people accountable in a professional manner.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Proficiency with project management and workflow software.



Ability to identify problems and independently drive solutions.



Experience in accounting, consulting, professional services, or other client-service businesses is highly desirable.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by:



Percentage of projects completed on schedule.



Percentage of assigned tasks completed by deadline.



Reduction in overdue client deliverables.



Employee accountability and productivity.



Accuracy and consistency of project tracking.



Timely identification and resolution of workflow issues.



Reduction in the amount of daily operational management required from ownership.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is not simply an administrator or task coordinator. We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of operations and managing people.



You should be:



Proactive rather than reactive.



Comfortable following up and holding people accountable.



Persistent about deadlines and commitments.



Organized and detail-oriented.



Confident communicating with employees and management.



Able to manage multiple projects without constant direction.



Focused on results, not just activity.



Position Structure



Position: Project Operations Manager



Engagement: Fractional / Part-Time / Potential Full-Time



Work Arrangement: Remote



Reporting To: Business Owner / Managing Partner



What Success Looks Like



The owner should no longer need to:



Chase employees for project updates.



Remind team members about deadlines.



Track every outstanding assignment.



Follow up repeatedly on client deliverables.



Resolve routine scheduling and workflow issues.



The Project Operations Manager owns daily execution, team accountability, and project progress, allowing ownership to focus on business development, client relationships, and strategic growth.

title: FULL-TIME SALES & RECRUITING VA – Cold Calling, Customer Service, Admin
description:
FULL-TIME SALES & RECRUITING VA – Cold Calling, Customer Service, Admin | US Home Services | $12,000+/year + Commission



2 Tone Wash is a fast-growing window and exterior cleaning company serving high-end brownstones in Brooklyn and Manhattan, NY. We're hiring ONE sharp, sales-driven assistant who is fluent in English, fluent in AI, and loves the phone. This is a long-term, full-time role with more hours and more earning potential every season.



This is not a basic appointment-setter role. You will learn our business as well as we know it: you'll quote jobs on the spot from Google Street View, pitch our seasonal plans, and close deals yourself. AI does the heavy lifting; you check it, manage it, and sell.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Now to February (off-season):

- Send 40+ personalized
s a day to college career centers, clubs and athletic departments across the US, and follow up until we're posted. Goal: 1,000+ colleges contacted.

- Post and manage our job listings (Handshake, Indeed and more), screen applicants and book interviews.

- Cold call storefronts, restaurants and property managers in Brooklyn and close recurring window cleaning accounts.

- Build clean lead lists from public sources. Every row has a source link and every
 is checked before it goes out.

- Research with links (storage units, equipment, vendors) and fact-check everything AI gives you.

- Daily report: done, next, needs approval.



March to November (season):

- Answer calls and texts from homeowners during business hours(9am-5pm mon-Sun).

- Quote on the spot from our price guide, pitch our seasonal plans, upsell, and book jobs.

- Schedule and route our crews, send confirmations and insurance certificates, and solve problems calmly.



SCHEDULE

- Off-season: full-time, Monday to Friday, 8 hours a day during New York business hours (night shift in the Philippines).

- From March: more hours. You'll cover our phones 6 to 7 days a week, 9am to 9pm New York time, and earn commission on every job you book on top of your base.



PAY

- $1,000/month base, reviewed after 90 days. $1,200/month base in season.

- $100 bonus after your first 30 days.

- 2% commission on everything you close above $5,000 in a week. Example: close $10,000 in a week and earn an extra $100 that week.

- $25 per upsell you sell.

- $100 for every hire you recruit who stays 30 days.

- $50+ for every commercial account that stays 3 months.

- All bonus terms provided in writing.



YOU ARE

- Excellent spoken and written English. You sound confident and natural on the phone.

- A real salesperson: you've closed deals, set appointments or worked a phone sales role, with numbers to prove it.

- Comfortable with ChatGPT/Claude, a CRM, and spreadsheets. You use AI to go fast, then you check every detail.

- Organized enough to send a lot of messages without a single wrong name,
 or price.

- A fast learner who wants to know the business deeply, not just read a script.

- Hungry for more work and more earnings as we grow.

- Honest, reliable, and calm under pressure.



HOW WE WORK

- Approved methods only: no scraping private data, no mass automated DMs. Texts only to people who opted in, and every
 has an opt-out.



TO APPLY (we read every answer)

Start your reply with the word "TONE". Then tell us:

1. Your best sales or cold-calling result, with numbers.

2. A workflow you built with AI that saved real time, the tool, and how you checked accuracy.

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial.

title: Video Editor for High-Spend DTC Ecom Ads

We're a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand looking for an A-player video editor who understands performance marketing, not just video editing.



We're actively scaling on Meta Ads and producing new creatives and iterations every week. We already have a structured creative strategy, defined customer avatars, proven winning ads, and detailed briefs.



What we need is an editor who can take our concepts and turn them into high-performing ads that actually get spend.



We're not looking for someone who simply follows instructions and cuts clips together. We want someone who understands WHY an ad works and can elevate the creative through strong visual storytelling.



What We're Looking For



1. Deep understanding of performance marketing



You know the difference between a beautiful video and a video that converts.



You understand metrics like Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS, and how editing decisions influence performance.



2. Direct response knowledge



You're familiar with concepts like Eugene Schwartz's awareness levels, customer psychology, emotional storytelling, and direct response advertising.



You understand that every second of an ad should have a purpose.



3. Experience with structured creative briefs



We provide detailed briefs with scripts, hook variations, visual references, creative direction, and CTAs.



You should be able to take a brief, understand the intended emotional journey, and bring it to life — not just mechanically follow instructions.



4. Strong AI editing capabilities



You're AI-first and actively use tools such as Runway, Kling, Sora, ElevenLabs, or similar platforms.



You know how to use AI to create realistic UGC-style content, B-roll, voiceovers, and visual assets that integrate naturally into performance ads.



We want someone who uses AI as part of their daily workflow, not someone who's just experimenting with it.



5. Experience iterating on winning ads



You understand the difference between ideation, iteration, and imitation.



You know how to create variations of successful ads while isolating specific variables such as hooks, pacing, visuals, or storytelling.



6. Proven experience with ads that scale



We're not interested in portfolios filled with cinematic edits or brand videos.



We want to see direct response ads you've edited that have actually performed on Meta or TikTok and received meaningful ad spend.



7. Performance creative education (strong advantage)



Experience with Ecom Talent (Karlo), Evolve, or similar structured training programs in performance marketing and creative strategy is a major plus.



What We Offer



Long-term collaboration with a growing e-commerce brand.



Consistent weekly creative production.



Detailed briefs, clear creative direction, and access to performance feedback.



Opportunities to work on winning creatives being scaled with significant ad budgets.



A creative environment focused on testing, learning, and improving results.



How to Apply



To apply for this position, you must complete and submit our application form using the link below:







Only candidates who complete the application form will be considered.



We're looking for an editor who thinks like a performance marketer, not just a video editor.



If you understand what makes an ad convert and know how to turn winning concepts into scalable creatives, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Outbound Appointment Setter: Roofing Owners, Free Audit Offer (Bring Your Own Dialer and A2P Setup)
description:
ABOUT CURAVIA STUDIO:

Curavia Studio is a young marketing studio in Bloomington, Indiana, serving roofing companies in the Indianapolis market. We build and run lead follow-up and appointment booking systems for roofers: ads on the client's own account, every lead answered in under five minutes, booking on the client's calendar, review requests, and a weekly report. We are honest about our stage: we are signing our first founding roofing partners now, and this hire is part of how we reach them. You would be our first acquisition setter, working directly with the founder's team.



THE JOB:

You sell conversations, not services. Your work is reaching roofing company owners and offering them two free things: a personalized audit of how their company captures and follows up leads (theirs to keep either way), and a short recorded demo of our system working on a real test lead. When an owner says yes, you book a free 15 to 30 minute growth call on our calendar. That is the win. You never pitch our price and you never close a sale; the decision happens later, in writing, without you on the line.



- Outbound calls to roofing owners from lists we provide (Indianapolis area first), working from a short written audit we prepare for each company

- Paced participation in roofing owner
 groups from our real business presence: helpful posts, real answers, conversations that end at the free audit offer

- DM follow-up with owners who engaged, inside our follow-up rules (one polite follow-up, then silence)

- Book calls on our calendar through our booking link and log every touch in our CRM (GoHighLevel) the same day

- Route any price, terms, or objection question to our team the same day instead of improvising an answer



Each week you receive a fresh call list from us: company names, owner names, phone numbers, and a short audit brief for each company. You never buy lists, and you never build or bring your own lists.



A HARD REQUIREMENT OF THIS SEAT: YOUR OWN CALLING SETUP.

You call on your own dialer and your own A2P-registered numbers, with your own compliance registration in good standing. Our own phone registration is still in process, which is exactly why this seat is structured this way. If you do not already have a working dialer and registered numbers you control, this posting is not for you. In your application, describe your setup in your own words (see the application questions). We will ask about it again in the interview.



HOURS:

- Part time, about 20 hours per week, scheduled in US Eastern Time calling windows (our owners are in Indiana, and owners answer before crews roll and after jobs wrap)

- Reliability matters more than volume: the windows you commit to are the windows you work

- A normal shift is 40 to 60 dials across your scheduled window, with every call logged the same day



REQUIREMENTS:

- Filipino VA working from home (this posting is for direct hire via OnlineJobs.ph)

- Excellent spoken English: roofing owners, often on a job site with noise around them, must understand you easily on the first pass. Written English must be clean enough for DMs an owner would forward to a partner

- A working dialer and A2P-registered numbers that you own or control, in good standing, described concretely in your application

- Prior outbound appointment-setting experience; roofing, home-services, or other contractor outbound experience is a strong plus

- Quiet workspace, good USB headset, reliable high-speed internet, and a backup connection plan you can describe

- Comfortable in a CRM: every touch logged the same day. GoHighLevel experience is a plus, any CRM discipline helps

- Comfortable being recorded and reviewed: our team listens to call recordings for coaching and quality

- Available to start within one week of an offer, and looking for a long-term seat



PAY (FIXED BASE SALARY PLUS PERFORMANCE BONUSES, STATED EXACTLY):

- Fixed base salary: $260 per month for part-time work at about 20 hours per week (about $60 per week). Paid weekly, in arrears, against a simple activity log (hours worked and calls made, from your dialer). The base salary is yours for the hours you work, whether or not a show happens that week. The first week is a paid trial week at this same base rate.

- How the base is verified (read this carefully): base pay is paid only against evidence, never against a report of effort. Every shift must produce (1) your dialer's call log for that shift (numbers dialed, call durations, outcomes), (2) call recordings, which our team reviews for quality, and (3) a CRM entry for every touch, logged the same day. Time with no dialer log, no recordings, or no CRM entries is not paid, because we cannot verify it happened. A normal shift is sustained outbound dialing across your scheduled window (we compare your volume with what you told us you have sustained in past roles, in your application). If the logs show the work, the base is paid in full and on time, every week.

- Plus $25 for every Qualified Show, on top of the base salary. A Qualified Show means: the owner or a decision maker of a roofing company in our target market attends the Free Growth Call you booked (a real attendance of at least 15 minutes), the booking was made by you and logged in our CRM before the call, and the company was not already in conversation with Curavia before your first touch. A booking alone is not a show. A no-show is not a show.

- Plus 5% of cash collected on clients whose first Qualified Show you booked: 5% of the Curavia fees that client actually pays and that clear (the buildout start and the monthly partnership payments). Client ad spend never counts; it is never ours. Paid after the client's payment clears, on the weekly pay cycle, 7 days after the underlying cash clears.

- Worked example, so there is no mystery: in a month where you book a show, the owner becomes a client, and Curavia collects a $300 buildout start plus the first $1,500 monthly payment, $1,800 total, you receive your $260 base salary plus the $25 show bonus plus $90 (5% of $1,800): $375 for that month.

- If a client payment you were paid a bonus on is later refunded or reversed, the matching bonus or percentage is reversed in the same proportion.



HOW TO APPLY: Answer every application question in this posting, in your own words. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for a voice recording and a live interview with a role-play. Copy-paste applications are deleted unread.



APPLICATION SCREENING QUESTIONS:

1. Your calling setup, in your own words. Name your dialer. Where do your numbers come from? How does your A2P registration work, and how do you handle opt-outs, do-not-call requests, and call recording consent? Be concrete: we are hiring this seat partly because the setup is yours, and we need to understand exactly what we are relying on.

2. How many outbound dials have you sustained per day in past roles, and in what industries? What did a normal shift look like?

3. Have you done outbound calling for roofing, home-services, or other contractor companies? Describe the offer you were setting appointments for.

4. Record a 30 to 60 second voice note introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this role, and attach or link it with your application.

5. Written pitch exercise. Write the first 3 sentences of a call to a roofing owner whose company you have never spoken to. You are offering a free audit of how his company captures and follows up leads. Write exactly what you would say, word for word. (We read this more closely than anything else in your application.)

6. An owner says: "Not interested. Do not call me again." Walk us through exactly what you do in the next 60 seconds, and exactly what you log in the CRM afterward.

7. Part of this seat is paced participation in roofing owner
 groups from our real business account: helpful posts, genuine answers, no spam, no extra profiles. Have you done community or group-based outreach before? Describe how you worked and what pace you kept.

8. Our owners are in Indiana (US Eastern Time). This seat is about 20 hours per week in Eastern calling windows. Which windows can you reliably cover every week, in Philippine time?

9. Describe your internet setup (provider, typical speed), your backup plan when it fails, your workspace, and your headset.

10. This seat pays a fixed base salary of $260 per month (part time, about 20 hours per week) plus a bonus per qualified show and a percentage of collected client fees. Have you worked a base-plus-bonus pay structure before? When could you start, and are you looking for long-term work?

title: Remote Sales Manager – Residential/Commercial Solar & Roofing ($8M+ Installed/Yr)
description:
🏢 **JOB OVERVIEW**

In an industry full of startups that disappear overnight, Smart Roofs Solar has been thriving for 15 years and is currently installing approximately $8 Million per year. We don't just sell panels; we operate across three high-ticket divisions: Residential Solar, Commercial Solar, and Residential Roofing.

Because you will be helping us scale an already-proven $8M/year operation, your monthly bonus is tied directly to total sales volume across all three divisions. If you know how to coach reps through residential kitchen-table objections, navigate commercial solar decision-makers, and keep sales and operations tightly aligned from contract to install, this role was built for you.



---



🎯 **WHAT YOU'LL DO:**



* Partner with the CEO, Operations & Sales: Work directly with executive leadership, operations, and our US and PH sales teams to build out this new remote leadership seat and ensure seamless alignment from initial pitch to final installation.

* Drive Multi-Company Revenue: Lead the charge across all three divisions—B2C (Residential Solar & Residential Roofing) and B2B (Commercial Solar)—ensuring reps know how to bundle and cross-sell roofing + solar deals to maximize volume.

* Refine the Playbook: Audit our CRM pipelines, eliminate bottlenecks between setters, closers, and project operations, and continuously upgrade scripts and rebuttals for both residential homeowners and commercial property owners.

* Build a Winning Culture: Foster a high-accountability, zero-excuse, results-driven remote sales floor where top performers are recognized and underperformers are coached up or out.



---



✅ **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (MUST-HAVES):**



* 5+ Years of Sales Management Experience: A verifiable track record of building, scaling, and managing remote B2C and B2B sales teams.

* Direct Industry Expertise: Hands-on experience in Residential Solar, Commercial Solar, and/or Residential Roofing is required. You must already understand the terminology, financing/PPA structures, roofing scopes, and buyer psychology of these markets.

* Cross-Department & Cross-Border Leadership: Proven ability to lead, motivate, and bridge the gap between PH-based appointment setters/inside sales reps, US-based closers, and internal operations teams.

* Data-Driven Operator: Strong command of CRM pipeline management, conversion metrics, and structured performance turnarounds.

* Remote Self-Starter: Highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable stepping into a newly created role where you can help shape the structure while aligning with US business hours.



---



💰 **COMPENSATION & PERKS:**



* Base Pay: $10.00/hour (Full-Time, 40 hrs/week)

* Monthly Sales Volume Bonus: Paid monthly based on total sales volume across all three companies/divisions. As this is a newly created remote role, exact tier structures will be finalized with the right candidate, with On-Target Earnings (OTE) of $10.00/hr base + $800 to $2,700/month in sales bonuses.

* Work Setup: 100% Work-From-Home

* Stability & Scale: Step into a leadership seat at a 15-year-old established organization already installing ~$8M annually, where your strategies will directly grow the bottom line—and your paycheck.



# ==================================================

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**



To be considered for an immediate interview with our CEO, first identify your **Priority Tier** based on your hands-on industry background:



* **TIER 1:** Commercial Solar + Residential Solar + Roofing Sales Managment Experience

* **TIER 2:** Residential Solar OR Commercial Solar  Sales Managment Experience (with or without Roofing)

* **TIER 3:** Roofing  Sales Managment Experience Only



Next, you **MUST** use the exact subject line format below when submitting your application on OnlineJobs.ph:



**Subject Line:** [Your Tier] – SOLAR ROOF LEADER – [Largest Team Size Managed] – [Your Specific Verticals]

*(Example: TIER 1 – SOLAR ROOF LEADER – 25 Reps – Comm Solar, Resi Solar & Roofing)*

In the body of your message, include 2–3 sentences sharing the biggest monthly or annual revenue volume a team achieved under your leadership.

Experience working with call-center or sales-team conversions

Experience launching and managing campaigns across multiple ad accounts and geographies

Ability to diagnose sudden performance drops even when CPM and CTR remain stable

Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

Good written and spoken English



Experience We Are Especially Interested In

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following will receive priority:



Affiliate marketing

High-ticket lead generation

VSL funnels

Call-center-based sales funnels

Qualified-lead or first-deposit optimization

International campaigns in Australia, the UK, Canada, or Europe

Multiple Meta ad accounts, pixels, pages, and tracking setups



Who Is Not a Good Fit

This role is probably not suitable for someone who:



Has only run small Shopify or dropshipping campaigns

Has never personally controlled campaign budgets

Optimizes only for ROAS or purchases inside an e-commerce store

Has no experience reviewing lead quality or downstream conversion data

Requires detailed instructions for every campaign decision

Cannot monitor campaigns during their active delivery windows

Has theoretical knowledge but cannot provide real campaign examples



E-commerce experience is welcome, but it cannot be your only experience.



What We Offer

Long-term, full-time opportunity

Competitive salary based on experience

Performance-based bonuses

Established funnels and active campaigns

Access to multiple accounts, markets, creatives, and performance data

Opportunity to manage significant budgets

Direct involvement in strategy, testing, and scaling

Opportunity to grow into a senior media buyer or media-buying team lead

We are looking for someone who takes ownership rather than simply waiting for instructions.

Be proactive and anticipate what needs to be done.

Follow through on assignments without repeated reminders.

Communicate clearly and consistently.

Keep systems, records, and tasks organized.

Bring problems forward along with potential solutions.

Protect confidential business information.

$4 per hour.

Part-time position.

 5. Tools We Provide

- SellerAmp

- Keepa

- Boxem or Arbitrack



6. Pay and Bonuses

Your starting pay will be $2.00 per hour during the trial. To graduate the trial, you must find 5 qualified leads in one week. Sounds easy, but it isn't.



If you perform well and meet our requirements, you can receive:



- Monthly pay raises

- Large performance bonuses

- Opportunities to increase your monthly earnings



Our top VA earns $1150 per month, and you can work toward earning this amount too.



Your performance, product quality, consistency, and ability to follow our sourcing method will determine your long-term opportunities.

- Have experience with SellerAmp and Keepa.

- Know how to use Keepa Product Finder.

- Can work 40 hours per week.

- Can consistently find ungated products for new Amazon sellers.
