title: Senior US Tax Accountant
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software.  Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Nice to have:

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule:   Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

 *Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

 *Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.

title: Appointment Setter (Real Estate Software) - Part-Time, US Pacific Hours, $4/hr + Bonuses
description:
Appointment Setter (Real Estate Software) - Part-Time, US Pacific Hours, $4/hr + Bonuses



Company: Lot Decoder

Location: Remote, Philippines-based

Hours: 20 hrs/week, Mon-Fri, 9:00 AM-1:00 PM US Pacific

(1:00 AM-5:00 AM Philippine time from Nov 1; 12:00 AM-4:00 AM during US daylight saving time)

Type: Independent contractor, paid 30-day trial, then ongoing

Payment: Every 2 weeks via Wise or Payoneer



START DATE

This role starts on Lot Decoder's app launch day, expected in the next few weeks. We are reviewing applications now. If you're selected, we'll confirm your exact start date by message before you begin. No work or training happens before that date.



PAY

- Base: $4.00/hr (about $350/month)

- $10 for each qualified demo you book and run

- $5 for each prospect who confirms their
 and runs a lookup on a real lot

- One-time sign-up bonuses for each customer you bring in, once paid plans open:

    Member monthly: $20

    Pro monthly: $50

    Member annual: $75

    Pro annual: $150

    Company plan: $150 + $10 for each paid seat



No cap on sign-up bonuses. During your first 30 days, demo and trial bonuses are capped at $200.

Demo and trial bonuses are paid on the next payday. Sign-up bonuses are paid after a 30-day hold and are cancelled if the customer gets a refund.



ABOUT LOT DECODER

Lot Decoder is software for US real estate agents, builders and land investors. They enter a vacant lot's address and get its zoning, what can be built on it, cost and profit estimates, and a step-by-step plan to buy and develop it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call and message US real estate agents and small home builders from lists we give you

- Briefly explain what Lot Decoder does and offer a free lot report

- Book and run 15-minute screen-share demos, and help each prospect sign up and finish their first free report

- Tap the result after every call in the Lot Decoder dialer (it logs everything for you)

- Follow our script and US calling rules every time



DAILY TARGETS (measured from your first live week)

- 80 hand dials a day

- 12 real conversations a day

- 2 demos booked a day

Missing the targets two weeks in a row means we talk about whether the role is a fit.



MUST HAVE

- Clear, confident spoken English with a neutral accent

- 1+ year of US outbound calling or appointment setting

- Quiet place to work, stable internet (25 Mbps+), backup power or internet

- Headset with a noise-cancelling mic

- Can work the hours above every weekday



NICE TO HAVE

- US real estate, mortgage or home-building calls

- Experience with HubSpot or another CRM

- Has sold or booked meetings for software products



TRAINING IN YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS (PAID)



1. Finish all 8 Lot Decoder courses and their quizzes in our Skool community within your first 30 days.

2. Be active in the community: introduce yourself, then make at least 3 helpful posts or replies a week.

3. Course time is paid at your normal hourly rate. On the Team page, pick "Training" when you clock in.

4. In the community, label yourself as "Lot Decoder Team". Never pose as a customer.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Use the subject line "Lot Setter - [Your Name]" (we use it to check you read the full post).

2. Send a 60-second voice recording introducing yourself as if you were calling a US real estate agent.

3. List your last 2 calling jobs: the product, who you called and your weekly booked meetings.

4. Send a screenshot of your internet speed test.



Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.

title: Lead Generation, Cold Calling & Sales Representative – $1/Hour + 10% Commission
description:
# Job Title: UK Lead Generation, Cold Calling & Sales Representative – $1/Hour + Commission



**Company:** Sole Bookkeeping (UK)  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Position:** Part-time / Full-time  

**Target Market:** United Kingdom



## About Sole Bookkeeping



Sole Bookkeeping is a UK-based online bookkeeping business providing bookkeeping services to sole traders, self-employed individuals and small businesses throughout the UK.



Our services include monthly bookkeeping, income and expense tracking, bank reconciliations, VAT returns, Making Tax Digital support and other bookkeeping services.



We are looking for a motivated, confident and results-driven individual to help us generate leads, contact UK businesses and secure new paying clients.



## Job Responsibilities



### 1. Lead Generation

- Research UK sole traders and small businesses across all industries.

- Find potential customers who may need bookkeeping services.

- Build and maintain business contact databases.

- Collect business names, publicly available
 addresses and telephone numbers.

- Organise leads using Excel or Google Sheets.

- Remove duplicate and inaccurate records.



### 2. Cold Calling

- Make outbound calls to UK businesses.

- Introduce Sole Bookkeeping and explain our services.

- Speak confidently with business owners.

- Identify businesses that may need bookkeeping assistance.

- Handle initial questions and objections professionally.

- Follow up with interested prospects.

- Arrange appointments with potential customers.

title: Vehicle Electrical Fitout Designer (12/24V)
description:
About RXI

RXI Group designs and builds service bodies and vehicle fitouts for fleet, utility and mining customers across Australia. Every build includes a custom electrical fitout: lighting, beacons, compressors, inverters, auxiliary batteries, controllers and CAN-based modules. We are building an in-house electrical design team and need someone who understands how these systems actually work on a vehicle.

The role

You will take a build scope and a list of components, and work out the full electrical fitout: what each device needs, where its power comes from, how it is switched, fused and earthed, and how it all ties back into the vehicle. You will then produce the schematic and wiring documentation the workshop builds from.

Key responsibilities

• Review build scopes and component datasheets, and work out the wiring requirements for each device

• Design 12/24V circuits: power source (main or auxiliary battery), isolators, fuses and circuit breakers, switches, relays and earths

• Develop electrical schematics and wiring diagrams for each build

• Select wire sizes, fuse ratings, connectors and terminals

• Prepare electrical BOMs

• Work with the workshop and installers to resolve fitout and installation issues

• Learn and use Onshape to route harnesses in 3D (full training provided)

Must have

• Hands-on or design experience with vehicle electrical fitouts, auto electrical, 4WD/fleet accessory installs, or automotive harness and EDS work

• Strong understanding of 12/24V vehicle systems, including dual battery setups, DC-DC chargers, isolators, relays, fusing and earthing

• Ability to look at a component and its datasheet and work out how to wire it, without being given a diagram

• Ability to draw clear schematics in AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, Zuken E3 or similar

• Good written English and able to work independently with an Australian team

Nice to have

• Electrical, electronics or automotive qualification

• Any 3D CAD experience





How to apply

Send your CV and a short note describing a vehicle electrical fitout or circuit you have designed or installed. Shortlisted applicants will complete a short practical test before interview.

________________________________________



Screening steps

1. Practical test first: candidate is given 2-3 fitout components (e.g. beacon, work light, compressor) and draws how to wire them (power source, fuse, switch, relay, earth), selects wire size and fuse rating, and explains why
